speaker: god
text: Before I formed you in the womb I knew you, and before you were born I set you apart and appointed you as a prophet to the nations.
name: The LORD

speaker: jeremiah
text: Ah, Lord GOD,
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: I surely do not know how to speak, for I am only a child!
name: Jeremiah

speaker: god
text: Do not say, ‘I am only a child.’ For to everyone I send you, you must go, and all that I command you, you must speak.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Do not be afraid of them, for I am with you to deliver you,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, I have put My words in your mouth.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: See, I have appointed you today over nations and kingdoms to uproot and tear down, to destroy and overthrow, to build and plant.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Jeremiah, what do you see?
name: The LORD

speaker: jeremiah
text: I see a branch of an almond tree,
name: Jeremiah

speaker: god
text: You have observed correctly,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: for I am watching over My word to accomplish it.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: What do you see?
name: The LORD

speaker: jeremiah
text: I see a boiling pot,
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: and it is tilting toward us from the north.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: god
text: Disaster from the north will be poured out on all who live in the land.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For I am about to summon all the clans and kingdoms of the north,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Their kings will come and set up their thrones at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem. They will attack all her surrounding walls and all the other cities of Judah.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will pronounce My judgments against them for all their wickedness, because they have forsaken Me to burn incense to other gods and to worship the works of their own hands.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Get yourself ready. Stand up and tell them everything that I command you. Do not be intimidated by them, or I will terrify you before them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Now behold, this day I have made you like a fortified city, an iron pillar, and bronze walls against the whole land—against the kings of Judah, its officials, its priests, and the people of the land.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They will fight against you but will never overcome you, since I am with you to deliver you,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Go and proclaim in the hearing of Jerusalem that this is what the LORD says: ‘I remember the devotion of your youth, your love as a bride, how you followed Me in the wilderness, in a land not sown.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Israel was holy to the LORD, the firstfruits of His harvest. All who devoured her found themselves guilty; disaster came upon them,’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: What fault did your fathers find in Me that they strayed so far from Me, and followed worthless idols, and became worthless themselves?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They did not ask, ‘Where is the LORD who brought us up from the land of Egypt, who led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and pits, a land of drought and darkness, a land where no one travels and no one lives?’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I brought you into a fertile land to eat its fruit and bounty, but you came and defiled My land, and made My inheritance detestable.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The priests did not ask, ‘Where is the LORD?’ The experts in the law no longer knew Me, and the leaders rebelled against Me. The prophets prophesied by Baal and followed useless idols.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore, I will contend with you again, declares the LORD, and I will bring a case against your children’s children.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Cross over to the coasts of Cyprus and take a look; send to Kedar and consider carefully; see if there has ever been anything like this:
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Has a nation ever changed its gods, though they are no gods at all? Yet My people have exchanged their Glory for useless idols.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Be stunned by this, O heavens; be shocked and utterly appalled,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For My people have committed two evils: They have forsaken Me, the fountain of living water, and they have dug their own cisterns— broken cisterns that cannot hold water.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Is Israel a slave? Was he born into slavery? Why then has he become prey?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The young lions have roared at him; they have growled with a loud voice. They have laid waste his land; his cities lie in ruins, without inhabitant.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The men of Memphis and Tahpanhes have shaved the crown of your head.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Have you not brought this on yourself by forsaking the LORD your God when He led you in the way?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Now what will you gain on your way to Egypt to drink the waters of the Nile? What will you gain on your way to Assyria to drink the waters of the Euphrates?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Your own evil will discipline you; your own apostasies will reprimand you. Consider and realize how evil and bitter it is for you to forsake the LORD your God and to have no fear of Me,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For long ago you broke your yoke and tore off your chains, saying, ‘I will not serve!’ Indeed, on every high hill and under every green tree you lay down as a prostitute.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I had planted you like a choice vine from the very best seed. How could you turn yourself before Me into a rotten, wild vine?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Although you wash with lye and use an abundance of soap, the stain of your guilt is still before Me,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: How can you say, ‘I am not defiled; I have not run after the Baals’? Look at your behavior in the valley; acknowledge what you have done. You are a swift young she-camel galloping here and there,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: a wild donkey at home in the wilderness, sniffing the wind in the heat of her desire. Who can restrain her passion? All who seek her need not weary themselves; in mating season they will find her.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You should have kept your feet from going bare and your throat from being thirsty. But you said, ‘It is hopeless! For I love foreign gods, and I must go after them.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: As the thief is ashamed when he is caught, so the house of Israel is disgraced. They, their kings, their officials, their priests, and their prophets
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: say to a tree, ‘You are my father,’ and to a stone, ‘You gave me birth.’ For they have turned their backs to Me and not their faces, yet in the time of trouble they beg, ‘Rise up and save us!’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But where are the gods you made for yourselves? Let them rise up in your time of trouble and save you if they can; for your gods are as numerous as your cities, O Judah.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Why do you bring a case against Me? You have all rebelled against Me,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I have struck your sons in vain; they accepted no discipline. Your own sword has devoured your prophets like a voracious lion.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Have I been a wilderness to Israel or a land of dense darkness? Why do My people say, ‘We are free to roam; we will come to You no more’?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Does a maiden forget her jewelry or a bride her wedding sash? Yet My people have forgotten Me for days without number.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: How skillfully you pursue love! Even the most immoral of women could learn from your ways.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Moreover, your skirts are stained with the blood of the innocent poor, though you did not find them breaking in. But in spite of all these things
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: you say, ‘I am innocent. Surely His anger will turn from me.’ Behold, I will judge you, because you say, ‘I have not sinned.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: How unstable you are, constantly changing your ways! You will be disappointed by Egypt just as you were by Assyria.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Moreover, you will leave that place with your hands on your head, for the LORD has rejected those you trust; you will not prosper by their help.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: If a man divorces his wife and she leaves him to marry another, can he ever return to her? Would not such a land be completely defiled? But you have played the harlot with many lovers— and you would return to Me?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Lift up your eyes to the barren heights and see. Is there any place where you have not been violated? You sat beside the highways waiting for your lovers, like a nomad in the desert. You have defiled the land with your prostitution and wickedness.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore the showers have been withheld, and no spring rains have fallen. Yet you have the brazen look of a prostitute; you refuse to be ashamed.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Have you not just called to Me, ‘My Father, You are my friend from youth.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Will He be angry forever? Will He be indignant to the end?’ This you have spoken, but you keep doing all the evil you can.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Have you seen what faithless Israel has done? She has gone up on every high hill and under every green tree to prostitute herself there.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I thought that after she had done all these things, she would return to Me. But she did not return, and her unfaithful sister Judah saw it.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: She saw that because faithless Israel had committed adultery, I gave her a certificate of divorce and sent her away. Yet that unfaithful sister Judah had no fear and prostituted herself as well.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Indifferent to her own infidelity, Israel had defiled the land and committed adultery with stones and trees.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Yet in spite of all this, her unfaithful sister Judah did not return to Me with all her heart, but only in pretense,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Faithless Israel has shown herself more righteous than unfaithful Judah.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Go, proclaim this message toward the north: ‘Return, O faithless Israel,’ declares the LORD. ‘I will no longer look on you with anger, for I am merciful,’ declares the LORD. ‘I will not be angry forever.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Only acknowledge your guilt, that you have rebelled against the LORD your God. You have scattered your favors to foreign gods under every green tree and have not obeyed My voice,’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Return, O faithless children,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: for I am your master, and I will take you—one from a city and two from a family—and bring you to Zion.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then I will give you shepherds after My own heart, who will feed you with knowledge and understanding.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: In those days, when you multiply and increase in the land,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: they will no longer discuss the ark of the covenant of the LORD. It will never come to mind, and no one will remember it or miss it, nor will another one be made.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: At that time Jerusalem will be called The Throne of the LORD, and all the nations will be gathered in Jerusalem to honor the name of the LORD. They will no longer follow the stubbornness of their evil hearts.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: In those days the house of Judah will walk with the house of Israel, and they will come together from the land of the north to the land that I gave to your fathers as an inheritance.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then I said, ‘How I long to make you My sons and give you a desirable land, the most beautiful inheritance of all the nations!’ I thought you would call Me ‘Father’ and never turn away from following Me.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But as a woman may betray her husband, so you have betrayed Me, O house of Israel,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Return, O faithless children, and I will heal your faithlessness.
name: The LORD

speaker: israelites
text: Here we are. We come to You, for You are the LORD our God.
name: The people of Judah

speaker: israelites
text: Surely deception comes from the hills, and commotion from the mountains. Surely the salvation of Israel is in the LORD our God.
name: The people of Judah

speaker: israelites
text: From our youth, that shameful god has consumed what our fathers have worked for— their flocks and herds, their sons and daughters.
name: The people of Judah

speaker: israelites
text: Let us lie down in our shame; let our disgrace cover us. We have sinned against the LORD our God, both we and our fathers; from our youth even to this day we have not obeyed the voice of the LORD our God.
name: The people of Judah

speaker: god
text: If you will return, O Israel, return to Me,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: If you will remove your detestable idols from My sight and no longer waver,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: and if you can swear, ‘As surely as the LORD lives,’ in truth, in justice, and in righteousness, then the nations will be blessed by Him, and in Him they will glory.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Break up your unplowed ground, and do not sow among the thorns.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Circumcise yourselves to the LORD, and remove the foreskins of your hearts, O men of Judah and people of Jerusalem. Otherwise, My wrath will break out like fire and burn with no one to extinguish it, because of your evil deeds.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Blow the ram’s horn throughout the land. Cry aloud and say, ‘Assemble yourselves and let us flee to the fortified cities.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Raise a signal flag toward Zion. Seek refuge! Do not delay! For I am bringing disaster from the north, and terrible destruction.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: A lion has gone up from his thicket, and a destroyer of nations has set out. He has left his lair to lay waste your land. Your cities will be reduced to ruins and lie uninhabited.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So put on sackcloth, mourn and wail, for the fierce anger of the LORD has not turned away from us.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: In that day,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: the king and officials will lose their courage. The priests will tremble in fear, and the prophets will be astounded.
name: The LORD

speaker: jeremiah
text: Ah, Lord GOD, how completely You have deceived this people and Jerusalem by saying, ‘You will have peace,’ while a sword is at our throats.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: god
text: A searing wind from the barren heights in the desert blows toward the daughter of My people, but not to winnow or to sift;
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: a wind too strong for that comes from Me. Now I also pronounce judgments against them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: A besieging army comes from a distant land; they raise their voices against the cities of Judah.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They surround her like men guarding a field, because she has rebelled against Me,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Your ways and deeds have brought this upon you. This is your punishment; how bitter it is, because it pierces to the heart!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For My people are fools; they have not known Me. They are foolish children, without understanding. They are skilled in doing evil, but they know not how to do good.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The whole land will be desolate, but I will not finish its destruction.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore the earth will mourn and the heavens above will grow dark. I have spoken, I have planned, and I will not relent or turn back.
name: The LORD

speaker: daughter-of-zion
text: Woe is me, for my soul faints before the murderers!
name: The Daughter of Zion

speaker: god
text: Go up and down the streets of Jerusalem. Look now and take note; search her squares. If you can find a single person, anyone who acts justly, anyone who seeks the truth, then I will forgive the city.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Although they say, ‘As surely as the LORD lives,’ they are swearing falsely.
name: The LORD

speaker: jeremiah
text: They are only the poor; they have played the fool, for they do not know the way of the LORD, the justice of their God.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: I will go to the powerful and speak to them. Surely they know the way of the LORD, the justice of their God.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: god
text: Why should I forgive you? Your children have forsaken Me and sworn by gods that are not gods. I satisfied their needs, yet they committed adultery and assembled at the houses of prostitutes.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They are well-fed, lusty stallions, each neighing after his neighbor’s wife.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Should I not punish them for these things?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Should I not avenge Myself on such a nation as this?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Go up through her vineyards and ravage them, but do not finish them off. Strip off her branches, for they do not belong to the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have been utterly unfaithful to Me,
name: The LORD

speaker: israelites
text: He will not do anything; harm will not come to us; we will not see sword or famine.
name: The people of Judah

speaker: israelites
text: The prophets are but wind, for the word is not in them. So let their own predictions befall them.
name: The people of Judah

speaker: god
text: Because you have spoken this word, I will make My words a fire in your mouth and this people the wood it consumes.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, I am bringing a distant nation against you, O house of Israel,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: It is an established nation, an ancient nation, a nation whose language you do not know and whose speech you do not understand.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Their quivers are like open graves; they are all mighty men.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They will devour your harvest and food; they will consume your sons and daughters; they will eat up your flocks and herds; they will feed on your vines and fig trees. With the sword they will destroy the fortified cities in which you trust.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Yet even in those days,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will not make a full end of you.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And when the people ask, ‘For what offense has the LORD our God done all these things to us?’ You are to tell them, ‘Just as you have forsaken Me and served foreign gods in your land, so will you serve foreigners in a land that is not your own.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Hear this, O foolish and senseless people, who have eyes but do not see, who have ears but do not hear.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Do you not fear Me?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Do you not tremble before Me, the One who set the sand as the boundary for the sea, an enduring barrier it cannot cross? The waves surge, but they cannot prevail. They roar but cannot cross it.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But these people have stubborn and rebellious hearts. They have turned aside and gone away.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They have not said in their hearts, ‘Let us fear the LORD our God, who gives the rains, both autumn and spring, in season, who keeps for us the appointed weeks of harvest.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Your iniquities have diverted these from you; your sins have deprived you of My bounty.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For among My people are wicked men; they watch like fowlers lying in wait; they set a trap to catch men.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Like cages full of birds, so their houses are full of deceit. Therefore they have become powerful and rich.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They have grown fat and sleek, and have excelled in the deeds of the wicked. They have not taken up the cause of the fatherless, that they might prosper; nor have they defended the rights of the needy.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Should I not punish them for these things?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Should I not avenge Myself on such a nation as this?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: A horrible and shocking thing has happened in the land.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests rule by their own authority. My people love it so, but what will you do in the end?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Run for cover, O sons of Benjamin; flee from Jerusalem! Sound the ram’s horn in Tekoa; send up a signal over Beth-haccherem, for disaster looms from the north, even great destruction.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Though she is beautiful and delicate, I will destroy the Daughter of Zion.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Shepherds and their flocks will come against her; they will pitch their tents all around her, each tending his own portion:
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: ‘Prepare for battle against her; rise up, let us attack at noon. Woe to us, for the daylight is fading; the evening shadows grow long.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Rise up, let us attack by night and destroy her fortresses!’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Cut down the trees and raise a siege ramp against Jerusalem. This city must be punished; there is nothing but oppression in her midst.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: As a well gushes its water, so she pours out her evil. Violence and destruction resound in her; sickness and wounds are ever before Me.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Be forewarned, O Jerusalem, or I will turn away from you; I will make you a desolation, a land without inhabitant.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Glean the remnant of Israel as thoroughly as a vine. Pass your hand once more like a grape gatherer over the branches.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Pour it out on the children in the street, and on the young men gathered together. For both husband and wife will be captured, the old and the very old alike.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Their houses will be turned over to others, their fields and wives as well, for I will stretch out My hand against the inhabitants of the land,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For from the least of them to the greatest, all are greedy for gain; from prophet to priest, all practice deceit.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They dress the wound of My people with very little care, saying, ‘Peace, peace,’ when there is no peace at all.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Are they ashamed of the abomination they have committed? No, they have no shame at all; they do not even know how to blush. So they will fall among the fallen; when I punish them, they will collapse,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Stand at the crossroads and look. Ask for the ancient paths: ‘Where is the good way?’ Then walk in it, and you will find rest for your souls. But they said, ‘We will not walk in it!’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I appointed watchmen over you and said, ‘Listen for the sound of the ram’s horn.’ But they answered, ‘We will not listen!’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore hear, O nations, and learn, O congregations, what will happen to them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Hear, O earth! I am bringing disaster on this people, the fruit of their own schemes, because they have paid no attention to My word and have rejected My instruction.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: What use to Me is frankincense from Sheba or sweet cane from a distant land? Your burnt offerings are not acceptable; your sacrifices do not please Me.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will lay stumbling blocks before this people; fathers and sons alike will be staggered; friends and neighbors will perish.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, an army is coming from the land of the north; a great nation is stirred up from the ends of the earth.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They grasp the bow and spear; they are cruel and merciless. Their voice roars like the sea, and they ride upon horses, lined up like men in formation against you, O Daughter of Zion.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I have appointed you to examine My people like ore, so you may know and try their ways.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: All are hardened rebels, walking around as slanderers. They are bronze and iron; all of them are corrupt.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The bellows blow fiercely, blasting away the lead with fire. The refining proceeds in vain, for the wicked are not purged.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They are called rejected silver, because the LORD has rejected them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Stand in the gate of the house of the LORD and proclaim this message: Hear the word of the LORD, all you people of Judah who enter through these gates to worship the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Thus says the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel: Correct your ways and deeds, and I will let you live in this place.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Do not trust in deceptive words, chanting: ‘This is the temple of the LORD, the temple of the LORD, the temple of the LORD.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For if you really correct your ways and deeds, if you act justly toward one another,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: if you no longer oppress the foreigner and the fatherless and the widow, and if you no longer shed innocent blood in this place or follow other gods to your own harm,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: then I will let you live in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers forever and ever.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But look, you keep trusting in deceptive words to no avail.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Will you steal and murder, commit adultery and perjury, burn incense to Baal, and follow other gods that you have not known,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: and then come and stand before Me in this house, which bears My Name, and say, ‘We are delivered, so we can continue with all these abominations’?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Has this house, which bears My Name, become a den of robbers in your sight? Yes, I too have seen it, declares the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But go now to the place in Shiloh where I first made a dwelling for My Name, and see what I did to it because of the wickedness of My people Israel.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And now, because you have done all these things, declares the LORD, and because I have spoken to you again and again but you would not listen, and I have called to you but you would not answer,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: therefore what I did to Shiloh I will now do to the house that bears My Name, the house in which you trust, the place that I gave to you and your fathers.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And I will cast you out of My presence, just as I have cast out all your brothers, all the descendants of Ephraim.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: As for you, do not pray for these people, do not offer a plea or petition on their behalf, and do not beg Me, for I will not listen to you.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Do you not see what they are doing in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The sons gather wood, the fathers light the fire, and the women knead the dough to make cakes for the Queen of Heaven; they pour out drink offerings to other gods to provoke Me to anger.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But am I the One they are provoking? declares the LORD. Is it not themselves they spite, to their own shame?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Behold, My anger and My fury will be poured out on this place, on man and beast, on the trees of the field and the produce of the land, and it will burn and not be extinguished.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: Add your burnt offerings to your other sacrifices and eat the meat yourselves!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For when I brought your fathers out of the land of Egypt, I did not merely command them about burnt offerings and sacrifices,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: but this is what I commanded them: Obey Me, and I will be your God, and you will be My people. You must walk in all the ways I have commanded you, so that it may go well with you.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Yet they did not listen or incline their ear, but they followed the stubborn inclinations of their own evil hearts. They went backward and not forward.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: From the day your fathers came out of the land of Egypt until this day, I have sent you all My servants the prophets again and again.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Yet they would not listen to Me or incline their ear, but they stiffened their necks and did more evil than their fathers.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: When you tell them all these things, they will not listen to you. When you call to them, they will not answer.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore you must say to them, ‘This is the nation that would not listen to the voice of the LORD their God and would not receive correction. Truth has perished; it has disappeared from their lips.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Cut off your hair and throw it away. Raise up a lamentation on the barren heights, for the LORD has rejected and forsaken the generation of His wrath.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For the people of Judah have done evil in My sight, declares the LORD. They have set up their abominations in the house that bears My Name, and so have defiled it.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They have built the high places of Topheth in the Valley of Hinnom so they could burn their sons and daughters in the fire—something I never commanded, nor did it even enter My mind.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when this place will no longer be called Topheth and the Valley of Hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter. For they will bury the dead in Topheth until there is no more room.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The corpses of this people will become food for the birds of the air and the beasts of the earth, and there will be no one to scare them away.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will remove from the cities of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem the sounds of joy and gladness and the voices of the bride and bridegroom, for the land will become a wasteland.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: At that time,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: the bones of the kings of Judah, the bones of the officials, the bones of the priests, the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the people of Jerusalem will be removed from their graves.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They will be exposed to the sun and moon, and to all the host of heaven which they have loved, served, followed, consulted, and worshiped. Their bones will not be gathered up or buried, but will become like dung lying on the ground.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And wherever I have banished them, the remnant of this evil family will choose death over life,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Do men fall and not get up again? Does one turn away and not return?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Why then have these people turned away? Why does Jerusalem always turn away? They cling to deceit; they refuse to return.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I have listened and heard; they do not speak what is right. No one repents of his wickedness, asking, ‘What have I done?’ Everyone has pursued his own course like a horse charging into battle.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Even the stork in the sky knows her appointed seasons. The turtledove, the swift, and the thrush keep their time of migration, but My people do not know the requirements of the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: How can you say, ‘We are wise, and the Law of the LORD is with us,’ when in fact the lying pen of the scribes has produced a deception?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The wise will be put to shame; they will be dismayed and trapped. Since they have rejected the word of the LORD, what wisdom do they really have?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore I will give their wives to other men and their fields to new owners. For from the least of them to the greatest, all are greedy for gain; from prophet to priest, all practice deceit.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They dress the wound of the daughter of My people with very little care, saying, ‘Peace, peace,’ when there is no peace at all.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Are they ashamed of the abomination they have committed? No, they have no shame at all; they do not even know how to blush. So they will fall among the fallen; when I punish them, they will collapse, says the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will take away their harvest, declares the LORD. There will be no grapes on the vine, nor figs on the tree, and even the leaf will wither. Whatever I have given them will be lost to them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For behold, I will send snakes among you, vipers that cannot be charmed, and they will bite you,
name: The LORD

speaker: exiles
text: Is the LORD no longer in Zion? Is her King no longer there?
name: The cry of my people

speaker: god
text: Why have they provoked Me to anger with their carved images, with their worthless foreign idols?
name: The LORD

speaker: israelites
text: The harvest has passed, the summer has ended, but we have not been saved.
name: The people of Judah

speaker: god
text: They bend their tongues like bows; lies prevail over truth in the land. For they proceed from evil to evil, and they do not take Me into account,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Let everyone guard against his neighbor; do not trust any brother, for every brother deals craftily, and every friend spreads slander.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Each one betrays his friend; no one tells the truth. They have taught their tongues to lie; they wear themselves out committing iniquity.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You dwell in the midst of deception; in their deceit they refuse to know Me,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, I will refine them and test them, for what else can I do because of the daughter of My people?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Their tongues are deadly arrows; they speak deception. With his mouth a man speaks peace to his neighbor, but in his heart he sets a trap for him.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Should I not punish them for these things? declares the LORD. Should I not avenge Myself on such a nation as this?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And I will make Jerusalem a heap of rubble, a haunt for jackals; and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation, without inhabitant.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: It is because they have forsaken My law, which I set before them; they have not walked in it or obeyed My voice.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Instead, they have followed the stubbornness of their hearts and gone after the Baals, as their fathers taught them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, I will feed this people wormwood and give them poisoned water to drink.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will scatter them among the nations that neither they nor their fathers have known, and I will send a sword after them until I have finished them off.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Take note, and summon the wailing women; send for the most skillful among them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Let them come quickly and take up a lament over us, that our eyes may overflow with tears, and our eyelids may gush with water.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For the sound of wailing is heard from Zion: ‘How devastated we are! How great is our shame! For we have abandoned the land because our dwellings have been torn down.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The corpses of men will fall like dung upon the open field, like newly cut grain behind the reaper, with no one to gather it.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Let not the wise man boast in his wisdom, nor the strong man in his strength, nor the wealthy man in his riches.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But let him who boasts boast in this, that he understands and knows Me, that I am the LORD, who exercises loving devotion, justice and righteousness on the earth— for I delight in these things,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, the days are coming,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: when I will punish all who are circumcised yet uncircumcised:
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Egypt, Judah, Edom, Ammon, Moab, and all the inhabitants of the desert who clip the hair of their temples. For all these nations are uncircumcised, and the whole house of Israel is uncircumcised in heart.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Do not learn the ways of the nations or be terrified by the signs in the heavens, though the nations themselves are terrified by them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For the customs of the peoples are worthless; they cut down a tree from the forest; it is shaped with a chisel by the hands of a craftsman.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They adorn it with silver and gold and fasten it with hammer and nails, so that it will not totter.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Like scarecrows in a cucumber patch, their idols cannot speak. They must be carried because they cannot walk. Do not fear them, for they can do no harm, and neither can they do any good.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: These gods, who have made neither the heavens nor the earth, will perish from this earth and from under these heavens.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, at this time I will sling out the inhabitants of the land and bring distress upon them so that they may be captured.
name: The LORD

speaker: jeremiah
text: This is truly my sickness, and I must bear it.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: god
text: Listen to the words of this covenant and tell them to the men of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You must tell them that this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Cursed is the man who does not obey the words of this covenant,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: which I commanded your forefathers when I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the iron furnace, saying, ‘Obey Me, and do everything I command you, and you will be My people, and I will be your God.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: This was in order to establish the oath I swore to your forefathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as it is to this day.
name: The LORD

speaker: jeremiah
text: Amen, LORD,
name: Jeremiah

speaker: god
text: Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying: Hear the words of this covenant and carry them out.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For from the time I brought your fathers out of the land of Egypt until today, I strongly warned them again and again, saying, ‘Obey My voice.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Yet they would not obey or incline their ears, but each one followed the stubbornness of his evil heart. So I brought on them all the curses of this covenant I had commanded them to follow but they did not keep.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: There is a conspiracy among the men of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They have returned to the sins of their forefathers who refused to obey My words. They have followed other gods to serve them. The house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken the covenant I made with their fathers.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore this is what the LORD says: ‘I am about to bring upon them a disaster that they cannot escape. They will cry out to Me, but I will not listen to them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then the cities of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem will go and cry out to the gods to which they have been burning incense, but these gods certainly will not save them in their time of disaster.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Your gods are indeed as numerous as your cities, O Judah; the altars of shame you have set up—the altars to burn incense to Baal—are as many as the streets of Jerusalem.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: As for you, do not pray for these people. Do not raise up a cry or a prayer on their behalf, for I will not be listening when they call out to Me in their time of disaster.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: What right has My beloved in My house, having carried out so many evil schemes? Can consecrated meat avert your doom, so that you can rejoice?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The LORD once called you a flourishing olive tree, beautiful with well-formed fruit. But with a mighty roar He will set it on fire, and its branches will be consumed.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The LORD of Hosts, who planted you, has decreed disaster against you on account of the evil that the house of Israel and the house of Judah have brought upon themselves, provoking Me to anger by burning incense to Baal.
name: The LORD

speaker: men-of-anathoth
text: Let us destroy the tree with its fruit; let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be remembered no more.
name: The men of Anathoth

speaker: men-of-anathoth
text: You must not prophesy in the name of the LORD, or you will die by our hand.
name: The men of Anathoth

speaker: god
text: I will punish them. Their young men will die by the sword, their sons and daughters by famine.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: There will be no remnant, for I will bring disaster on the people of Anathoth in the year of their punishment.
name: The LORD

speaker: israelites
text: He cannot see what our end will be.
name: The people of Judah

speaker: god
text: If you have raced with men on foot and they have worn you out, how can you compete with horses? If you stumble in a peaceful land, how will you do in the thickets of the Jordan?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Even your brothers— your own father’s household— even they have betrayed you; even they have cried aloud against you. Do not trust them, though they speak well of you.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I have forsaken My house; I have abandoned My inheritance. I have given the love of My life into the hands of her enemies.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: My inheritance has become to Me like a lion in the forest. She has roared against Me; therefore I hate her.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Is not My inheritance to Me like a speckled bird of prey with other birds of prey circling against her? Go, gather all the beasts of the field; bring them to devour her.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Many shepherds have destroyed My vineyard; they have trampled My plot of ground. They have turned My pleasant field into a desolate wasteland.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They have made it a desolation; desolate before Me, it mourns. All the land is laid waste, but no man takes it to heart.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Over all the barren heights in the wilderness the destroyers have come, for the sword of the LORD devours from one end of the earth to the other. No flesh has peace.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They have sown wheat but harvested thorns. They have exhausted themselves to no avail. Bear the shame of your harvest because of the fierce anger of the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: As for all My evil neighbors who attack the inheritance that I bequeathed to My people Israel, I am about to uproot them from their land, and I will uproot the house of Judah from among them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But after I have uprooted them, I will once again have compassion on them and return each one to his inheritance and to his land.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And if they will diligently learn the ways of My people and swear by My name, saying, ‘As surely as the LORD lives’—just as they once taught My people to swear by Baal—then they will be established among My people.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But if they will not obey, then I will uproot that nation; I will uproot it and destroy it, declares the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Go and buy yourself a linen loincloth and put it around your waist, but do not let it touch water.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Take the loincloth that you bought and are wearing, and go at once to Perath and hide it there in a crevice of the rocks.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Arise, go to Perath, and get the loincloth that I commanded you to hide there.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: This is what the LORD says: In the same way I will ruin the pride of Judah and the great pride of Jerusalem.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: These evil people, who refuse to listen to My words, who follow the stubbornness of their own hearts, and who go after other gods to serve and worship them, they will be like this loincloth—of no use at all.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For just as a loincloth clings to a man’s waist, so I have made the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah cling to Me, declares the LORD, so that they might be My people for My renown and praise and glory. But they did not listen.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore you are to tell them that this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Every wineskin shall be filled with wine.’ And when they reply, ‘Don’t we surely know that every wineskin should be filled with wine?’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: then you are to tell them that this is what the LORD says: ‘I am going to fill with drunkenness all who live in this land—the kings who sit on David’s throne, the priests, the prophets, and all the people of Jerusalem.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will smash them against one another, fathers and sons alike, declares the LORD. I will allow no mercy or pity or compassion to keep Me from destroying them.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Take a lowly seat, for your glorious crowns have fallen from your heads.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will scatter you like chaff driven by the desert wind.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: This is your lot, the portion I have measured to you,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: because you have forgotten Me and trusted in falsehood.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So I will pull your skirts up over your face, that your shame may be seen.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Your adulteries and lustful neighings, your shameless prostitution on the hills and in the fields— I have seen your detestable acts. Woe to you, O Jerusalem! How long will you remain unclean?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Judah mourns and her gates languish. Her people wail for the land, and a cry goes up from Jerusalem.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The nobles send their servants for water; they go to the cisterns, but find no water; their jars return empty. They are ashamed and humiliated; they cover their heads.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The ground is cracked because no rain has fallen on the land. The farmers are ashamed; they cover their heads.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Even the doe in the field deserts her newborn fawn because there is no grass.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Wild donkeys stand on barren heights; they pant for air like jackals; their eyes fail for lack of pasture.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Truly they love to wander; they have not restrained their feet. So the LORD does not accept them; He will now remember their guilt and call their sins to account.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Do not pray for the well-being of this people.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Although they may fast, I will not listen to their cry; although they may offer burnt offerings and grain offerings, I will not accept them. Instead, I will finish them off by sword and famine and plague.
name: The LORD

speaker: jeremiah
text: Ah, Lord GOD!
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: Look, the prophets are telling them, ‘You will not see the sword or suffer famine, but I will give you lasting peace in this place.’
name: Jeremiah

speaker: god
text: The prophets are prophesying lies in My name,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I did not send them or appoint them or speak to them. They are prophesying to you a false vision, a worthless divination, the futility and delusion of their own minds.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore this is what the LORD says about the prophets who prophesy in My name: I did not send them, yet they say, ‘No sword or famine will touch this land.’ By sword and famine these very prophets will meet their end!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And the people to whom they prophesy will be thrown into the streets of Jerusalem because of famine and sword. There will be no one to bury them or their wives, their sons or their daughters. I will pour out their own evil upon them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You are to speak this word to them: ‘My eyes overflow with tears; day and night they do not cease, for the virgin daughter of my people has been shattered by a crushing blow, a severely grievous wound.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: If I go out to the country, I see those slain by the sword; if I enter the city, I see those ravaged by famine! For both prophet and priest travel to a land they do not know.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Even if Moses and Samuel should stand before Me, My heart would not go out to this people. Send them from My presence, and let them go.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: If they ask you, ‘Where shall we go?’ you are to tell them that this is what the LORD says: ‘Those destined for death, to death; those destined for the sword, to the sword; those destined for famine, to famine; and those destined for captivity, to captivity.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will appoint over them four kinds of destroyers, declares the LORD: the sword to kill, the dogs to drag away, and the birds of the air and beasts of the earth to devour and destroy.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will make them a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth because of what Manasseh son of Hezekiah king of Judah did in Jerusalem.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Who will have pity on you, O Jerusalem? Who will mourn for you? Who will turn aside to ask about your welfare?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You have forsaken Me, declares the LORD. You have turned your back. So I will stretch out My hand against you and I will destroy you; I am weary of showing compassion.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will scatter them with a winnowing fork at the gates of the land. I will bereave and destroy My people who have not turned from their ways.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will make their widows more numerous than the sand of the sea. I will bring a destroyer at noon against the mothers of young men. I will suddenly bring upon them anguish and dismay.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The mother of seven will grow faint; she will breathe her last breath. Her sun will set while it is still day; she will be disgraced and humiliated. And the rest I will put to the sword in the presence of their enemies,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Surely I will deliver you for a good purpose; surely I will intercede with your enemy in your time of trouble, in your time of distress.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Can anyone smash iron— iron from the north—or bronze?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Your wealth and your treasures I will give up as plunder, without charge for all your sins within all your borders.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then I will enslave you to your enemies in a land you do not know, for My anger will kindle a fire that will burn against you.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: If you return, I will restore you; you will stand in My presence. And if you speak words that are noble instead of worthless, you will be My spokesman. It is they who must turn to you, but you must not turn to them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then I will make you a wall to this people, a fortified wall of bronze; they will fight against you but will not overcome you, for I am with you to save and deliver you, declares the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will deliver you from the hand of the wicked and redeem you from the grasp of the ruthless.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You must not marry or have sons or daughters in this place.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They will die from deadly diseases. They will not be mourned or buried, but will lie like dung on the ground. They will be finished off by sword and famine, and their corpses will become food for the birds of the air and beasts of the earth.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Do not enter a house where there is a funeral meal. Do not go to mourn or show sympathy, for I have removed from this people My peace, My loving devotion, and My compassion,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Both great and small will die in this land. They will not be buried or mourned, nor will anyone cut himself or shave his head for them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: No food will be offered to comfort those who mourn the dead; not even a cup of consolation will be given for the loss of a father or mother.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You must not enter a house where there is feasting and sit down with them to eat and drink.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: I am going to remove from this place, before your very eyes and in your days, the sounds of joy and gladness, the voices of the bride and bridegroom.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: When you tell these people all these things, they will ask you, ‘Why has the LORD pronounced all this great disaster against us? What is our guilt? What is the sin that we have committed against the LORD our God?’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then you are to answer them: ‘It is because your fathers have forsaken Me, declares the LORD, and followed other gods, and served and worshiped them. They abandoned Me and did not keep My instruction.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And you have done more evil than your fathers. See how each of you follows the stubbornness of his evil heart instead of obeying Me.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So I will cast you out of this land into a land that neither you nor your fathers have known. There you will serve other gods day and night, for I will show you no favor.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Yet behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when they will no longer say, ‘As surely as the LORD lives, who brought the Israelites up out of the land of Egypt.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Instead they will say, ‘As surely as the LORD lives, who brought the Israelites up out of the land of the north and all the other lands to which He had banished them.’ For I will return them to their land that I gave to their forefathers.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But for now I will send for many fishermen, declares the LORD, and they will catch them. After that I will send for many hunters, and they will hunt them down on every mountain and hill, even from the clefts of the rocks.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For My eyes are on all their ways. They are not hidden from My face, and their guilt is not concealed from My eyes.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And I will first repay them double their iniquity and their sin, because they have defiled My land with the carcasses of their detestable idols, and they have filled My inheritance with their abominations.
name: The LORD

speaker: nations
text: Our fathers inherited nothing but lies, worthless idols of no benefit at all.
name: The nations

speaker: nations
text: Can man make gods for himself? Such are not gods!
name: The nations

speaker: god
text: Therefore behold, I will inform them, and this time I will make them know My power and My might; then they will know that My name is the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The sin of Judah is written with an iron stylus, engraved with a diamond point on the tablets of their hearts and on the horns of their altars.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Even their children remember their altars and Asherah poles by the green trees and on the high hills.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: O My mountain in the countryside, I will give over your wealth and all your treasures as plunder, because of the sin of your high places, within all your borders.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And you yourself will relinquish the inheritance that I gave you. I will enslave you to your enemies in a land that you do not know, for you have kindled My anger; it will burn forever.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Cursed is the man who trusts in mankind, who makes the flesh his strength and turns his heart from the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: He will be like a shrub in the desert; he will not see when prosperity comes. He will dwell in the parched places of the desert, in a salt land where no one lives.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, whose confidence is in Him.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: He is like a tree planted by the waters that sends out its roots toward the stream. It does not fear when the heat comes, and its leaves are always green. It does not worry in a year of drought, nor does it cease to produce fruit.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The heart is deceitful above all things and beyond cure. Who can understand it?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I, the LORD, search the heart; I examine the mind to reward a man according to his way, by what his deeds deserve.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Like a partridge hatching eggs it did not lay is the man who makes a fortune unjustly. In the middle of his days his riches will desert him, and in the end he will be the fool.
name: The LORD

speaker: scoffers
text: Where is the word of the LORD? Let it come now!
name: The scoffers

speaker: god
text: Go and stand at the gate of the people, through which the kings of Judah go in and out; and stand at all the other gates of Jerusalem.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Say to them, ‘Hear the word of the LORD, O kings of Judah, all people of Judah and Jerusalem who enter through these gates.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: This is what the LORD says: Take heed for yourselves; do not carry a load or bring it through the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You must not carry a load out of your houses or do any work on the Sabbath day, but you must keep the Sabbath day holy, just as I commanded your forefathers.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Yet they would not listen or incline their ear, but they stiffened their necks and would not listen or receive My discipline.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: If, however, you listen carefully to Me, says the LORD, and bring no load through the gates of this city on the Sabbath day, and keep the Sabbath day holy, and do no work on it,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: then kings and princes will enter through the gates of this city. They will sit on the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses with their officials, along with the men of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem, and this city will be inhabited forever.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And people will come from the cities of Judah and the places around Jerusalem, from the land of Benjamin, and from the foothills, the hill country, and the Negev, bringing burnt offerings and sacrifices, grain offerings and frankincense, and thank offerings to the house of the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But if you do not listen to Me to keep the Sabbath day holy by not carrying a load while entering the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day, then I will kindle an unquenchable fire in its gates to consume the citadels of Jerusalem.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Go down at once to the potter’s house, and there I will reveal My message to you.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: O house of Israel, declares the LORD, can I not treat you as this potter treats his clay? Just like clay in the potter’s hand, so are you in My hand, O house of Israel.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: At any time I might announce that a nation or kingdom will be uprooted, torn down, and destroyed.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But if that nation I warned turns from its evil, then I will relent of the disaster I had planned to bring.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And if at another time I announce that I will build up and establish a nation or kingdom,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: and if it does evil in My sight and does not listen to My voice, then I will relent of the good I had intended for it.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Now therefore, tell the men of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem that this is what the LORD says: ‘Behold, I am planning a disaster for you and devising a plan against you. Turn now, each of you, from your evil ways, and correct your ways and deeds.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But they will reply, ‘It is hopeless. We will follow our own plans, and each of us will act according to the stubbornness of his evil heart.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Inquire among the nations: Who has ever heard things like these? Virgin Israel has done a most terrible thing.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Does the snow of Lebanon ever leave its rocky slopes? Or do its cool waters flowing from a distance ever run dry?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Yet My people have forgotten Me. They burn incense to worthless idols that make them stumble in their ways, leaving the ancient roads to walk on rutted bypaths instead of on the highway.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They have made their land a desolation, a perpetual object of scorn; all who pass by will be appalled and shake their heads.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will scatter them before the enemy like the east wind. I will show them My back and not My face in the day of their calamity.
name: The LORD

speaker: conspirators
text: Come, let us make plans against Jeremiah, for the law will never be lost to the priest, nor counsel to the wise, nor an oracle to the prophet. Come, let us denounce him and pay no heed to any of his words.
name: Jeremiah's enemies

speaker: god
text: Go and buy a clay jar from a potter. Take some of the elders of the people and leaders of the priests,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: and go out to the Valley of Ben-hinnom near the entrance of the Potsherd Gate. Proclaim there the words I speak to you,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: saying, ‘Hear the word of the LORD, O kings of Judah and residents of Jerusalem. This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: I am going to bring such disaster on this place that the ears of all who hear of it will ring,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: because they have abandoned Me and made this a foreign place. They have burned incense in this place to other gods that neither they nor their fathers nor the kings of Judah have ever known. They have filled this place with the blood of the innocent.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They have built high places to Baal on which to burn their children in the fire as offerings to Baal—something I never commanded or mentioned, nor did it even enter My mind.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when this place will no longer be called Topheth or the Valley of Ben-hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And in this place I will ruin the plans of Judah and Jerusalem. I will make them fall by the sword before their enemies, by the hands of those who seek their lives, and I will give their carcasses as food to the birds of the air and the beasts of the earth.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will make this city a desolation and an object of scorn. All who pass by will be appalled and will scoff at all her wounds.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will make them eat the flesh of their sons and daughters, and they will eat one another’s flesh in the siege and distress inflicted on them by their enemies who seek their lives.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then you are to shatter the jar in the presence of the men who accompany you,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: and you are to proclaim to them that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: I will shatter this nation and this city, like one shatters a potter’s jar that can never again be repaired. They will bury the dead in Topheth until there is no more room to bury them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: This is what I will do to this place and to its residents, declares the LORD. I will make this city like Topheth.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The houses of Jerusalem and the houses of the kings of Judah will be defiled like that place, Topheth—all the houses on whose rooftops they burned incense to all the host of heaven and poured out drink offerings to other gods.
name: The LORD

speaker: jeremiah
text: This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘Behold, I am about to bring on this city and on all the villages around it every disaster I have pronounced against them, because they have stiffened their necks so as not to heed My words.’
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: The LORD does not call you Pashhur, but Magor-missabib.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: For this is what the LORD says: ‘I will make you a terror to yourself and to all your friends. They will fall by the sword of their enemies before your very eyes. And I will hand Judah over to the king of Babylon, and he will carry them away to Babylon and put them to the sword.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: I will give away all the wealth of this city—all its products and valuables, and all the treasures of the kings of Judah—to their enemies. They will plunder them, seize them, and carry them off to Babylon.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: And you, Pashhur, and all who live in your house, will go into captivity. You will go to Babylon, and there you will die and be buried—you and all your friends to whom you have prophesied these lies.’
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: I will not mention Him or speak any more in His name,
name: Jeremiah

speaker: conspirators
text: Terror is on every side! Report him; let us report him!
name: Jeremiah's enemies

speaker: conspirators
text: Perhaps he will be deceived so that we may prevail against him and take our vengeance upon him.
name: Jeremiah's enemies

speaker: pashhur
text: Please inquire of the LORD on our behalf, since Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon is waging war against us. Perhaps the LORD will perform for us something like all His past wonders, so that Nebuchadnezzar will withdraw from us.
name: Pashhur and Zephaniah

speaker: jeremiah
text: You are to tell Zedekiah that
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘I will turn against you the weapons of war in your hands, with which you are fighting the king of Babylon and the Chaldeans who besiege you outside the wall, and I will assemble their forces in the center of this city.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: And I Myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and a mighty arm, with anger, fury, and great wrath.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: I will strike down the residents of this city, both man and beast. They will die in a terrible plague.’
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: ‘After that,’ declares the LORD, ‘I will hand over Zedekiah king of Judah, his officers, and the people in this city who survive the plague and sword and famine, to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and to their enemies who seek their lives. He will put them to the sword; he will not spare them or show pity or compassion.’
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: Furthermore, you are to tell this people that this is what the LORD says: ‘Behold, I set before you the way of life and the way of death.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: Whoever stays in this city will die by sword and famine and plague, but whoever goes out and surrenders to the Chaldeans who besiege you will live; he will retain his life like a spoil of war.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: For I have set My face against this city to bring disaster and not good, declares the LORD. It will be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, who will destroy it with fire.’
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: Moreover, tell the house of the king of Judah to hear the word of the LORD.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: O house of David, this is what the LORD says: ‘Administer justice every morning, and rescue the victim of robbery from the hand of his oppressor, or My wrath will go forth like fire and burn with no one to extinguish it because of their evil deeds.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: Behold, I am against you who dwell above the valley, atop the rocky plateau— declares the LORD— you who say, “Who can come against us? Who can enter our dwellings?”
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: I will punish you as your deeds deserve, declares the LORD. I will kindle a fire in your forest that will consume everything around you.’
name: Jeremiah

speaker: god
text: Go down to the palace of the king of Judah and proclaim this message there,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: saying, ‘Hear the word of the LORD, O king of Judah, who sits on the throne of David—you and your officials and your people who enter these gates.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: This is what the LORD says: Administer justice and righteousness. Rescue the victim of robbery from the hand of his oppressor. Do no wrong or violence to the foreigner, the fatherless, or the widow. Do not shed innocent blood in this place.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For if you will indeed carry out these commands, then kings who sit on David’s throne will enter through the gates of this palace riding on chariots and horses—they and their officials and their people.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But if you do not obey these words, then I swear by Myself, declares the LORD, that this house will become a pile of rubble.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You are like Gilead to Me, like the summit of Lebanon; but I will surely turn you into a desert, like cities that are uninhabited.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will appoint destroyers against you, each man with his weapons, and they will cut down the choicest of your cedars and throw them into the fire.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And many nations will pass by this city and ask one another, ‘Why has the LORD done such a thing to this great city?’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then people will reply, ‘Because they have forsaken the covenant of the LORD their God and have worshiped and served other gods.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: He will never return,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: but he will die in the place to which he was exiled; he will never see this land again.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Woe to him who builds his palace by unrighteousness, and his upper rooms without justice, who makes his countrymen serve without pay, and fails to pay their wages,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: who says, ‘I will build myself a great palace, with spacious upper rooms.’ So he cuts windows in it, panels it with cedar, and paints it with vermilion.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Does it make you a king to excel in cedar? Did not your father have food and drink? He administered justice and righteousness, and so it went well with him.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: He took up the cause of the poor and needy, and so it went well with him. Is this not what it means to know Me?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But your eyes and heart are set on nothing except your own dishonest gain, on shedding innocent blood, on practicing extortion and oppression.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They will not mourn for him: ‘Alas, my brother! Alas, my sister!’ They will not mourn for him: ‘Alas, my master! Alas, his splendor!’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: He will be buried like a donkey, dragged away and thrown outside the gates of Jerusalem.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Go up to Lebanon and cry out; raise your voice in Bashan; cry out from Abarim, for all your lovers have been crushed.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I warned you when you were secure. You said, ‘I will not listen.’ This has been your way from youth, that you have not obeyed My voice.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The wind will drive away all your shepherds, and your lovers will go into captivity. Then you will be ashamed and humiliated because of all your wickedness.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: O inhabitant of Lebanon, nestled in the cedars, how you will groan when pangs of anguish come upon you, agony like a woman in labor.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: As surely as I live,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: even if you, Coniah son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, were a signet ring on My right hand, I would pull you off.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: In fact, I will hand you over to those you dread, who want to take your life—to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and to the Chaldeans.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will hurl you and the mother who gave you birth into another land, where neither of you were born—and there you both will die.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You will never return to the land for which you long.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Enroll this man as childless, a man who will not prosper in his lifetime. None of his descendants will prosper to sit on the throne of David or to rule again in Judah.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Woe to the shepherds who destroy and scatter the sheep of My pasture!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You have scattered My flock and driven them away, and have not attended to them. Behold, I will attend to you for the evil of your deeds, declares the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then I Myself will gather the remnant of My flock from all the lands to which I have banished them, and I will return them to their pasture, where they will be fruitful and multiply.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will raise up shepherds over them who will tend them, and they will no longer be afraid or dismayed, nor will any go missing, declares the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when I will raise up for David a righteous Branch, and He will reign wisely as King and will administer justice and righteousness in the land.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: In His days Judah will be saved, and Israel will dwell securely. And this is His name by which He will be called: The LORD Our Righteousness.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when they will no longer say, ‘As surely as the LORD lives, who brought the Israelites up out of the land of Egypt.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Instead they will say, ‘As surely as the LORD lives, who brought and led the descendants of the house of Israel up out of the land of the north and all the other lands to which He had banished them.’ Then they will dwell once more in their own land.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For both prophet and priest are ungodly; even in My house I have found their wickedness,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore their path will become slick; they will be driven away into the darkness and fall into it. For I will bring disaster upon them in the year of their punishment,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Among the prophets of Samaria I saw an offensive thing: They prophesied by Baal and led My people Israel astray.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And among the prophets of Jerusalem I have seen a horrible thing: They commit adultery and walk in lies. They strengthen the hands of evildoers, so that no one turns his back on wickedness. They are all like Sodom to Me; the people of Jerusalem are like Gomorrah.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will feed them wormwood and give them poisoned water to drink, for from the prophets of Jerusalem ungodliness has spread throughout the land.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Do not listen to the words of the prophets who prophesy to you. They are filling you with false hopes. They speak visions from their own minds, not from the mouth of the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They keep saying to those who despise Me, ‘The LORD says that you will have peace,’ and to everyone who walks in the stubbornness of his own heart, ‘No harm will come to you.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But which of them has stood in the council of the LORD to see and hear His word? Who has given heed to His word and obeyed it?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, the storm of the LORD has gone out with fury, a whirlwind swirling down upon the heads of the wicked.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The anger of the LORD will not turn back until He has fully accomplished the purposes of His heart. In the days to come you will understand this clearly.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I did not send these prophets, yet they have run with their message; I did not speak to them, yet they have prophesied.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But if they had stood in My council, they would have proclaimed My words to My people and turned them back from their evil ways and deeds.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Am I only a God nearby,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: and not a God far away?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Can a man hide in secret places where I cannot see him?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Do I not fill the heavens and the earth?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I have heard the sayings of the prophets who prophesy lies in My name: ‘I had a dream! I had a dream!’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: How long will this continue in the hearts of these prophets who prophesy falsehood, these prophets of the delusion of their own minds?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They suppose the dreams that they tell one another will make My people forget My name, just as their fathers forgot My name through the worship of Baal.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Let the prophet who has a dream retell it, but let him who has My word speak it truthfully. For what is straw compared to grain?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Is not My word like fire,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: and like a hammer that smashes a rock?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore behold,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
