text: I am against the prophets who steal from one another words they attribute to Me.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Yes,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I am against the prophets who wag their own tongues and proclaim, ‘The LORD declares it.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Indeed,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I am against those who prophesy false dreams and retell them to lead My people astray with their reckless lies. It was not I who sent them or commanded them, and they are of no benefit at all to these people,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Now when this people or a prophet or priest asks you, ‘What is the burden of the LORD?’ you are to say to them, ‘What burden? I will forsake you, declares the LORD.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: As for the prophet or priest or anyone who claims, ‘This is the burden of the LORD,’ I will punish that man and his household.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: This is what each man is to say to his friend and to his brother: ‘What has the LORD answered?’ or ‘What has the LORD spoken?’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But refer no more to the burden of the LORD, for each man’s word becomes the burden, so that you pervert the words of the living God, the LORD of Hosts, our God.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Thus you are to say to the prophet: ‘What has the LORD answered you?’ and ‘What has the LORD spoken?’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But if you claim, ‘This is the burden of the LORD,’ then this is what the LORD says: Because you have said, ‘This is the burden of the LORD,’ and I specifically told you not to make this claim,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: therefore I will surely forget you and will cast you out of My presence, both you and the city that I gave to you and your fathers.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And I will bring upon you everlasting shame and perpetual humiliation that will never be forgotten.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Jeremiah,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: what do you see?
name: The LORD

speaker: jeremiah
text: Figs!
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: The good figs are very good, but the bad figs are very bad, so bad they cannot be eaten.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: god
text: This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Like these good figs, so I regard as good the exiles from Judah, whom I have sent away from this place to the land of the Chaldeans.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will keep My eyes on them for good and will return them to this land. I will build them up and not tear them down; I will plant them and not uproot them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will give them a heart to know Me, that I am the LORD. They will be My people, and I will be their God, for they will return to Me with all their heart.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But like the bad figs, so bad they cannot be eaten,’ says the LORD, ‘so will I deal with Zedekiah king of Judah, his officials, and the remnant of Jerusalem—those remaining in this land and those living in the land of Egypt.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will make them a horror and an offense to all the kingdoms of the earth, a disgrace and an object of scorn, ridicule, and cursing wherever I have banished them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And I will send against them sword and famine and plague, until they have perished from the land that I gave to them and their fathers.’
name: The LORD

speaker: jeremiah
text: From the thirteenth year of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah until this very day—twenty-three years—the word of the LORD has come to me, and I have spoken to you again and again, but you have not listened.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: And the LORD has sent all His servants the prophets to you again and again, but you have not listened or inclined your ear to hear.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: The prophets told you, ‘Turn now, each of you, from your evil ways and deeds, and you can dwell in the land that the LORD has given to you and your fathers forever and ever.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: Do not follow other gods to serve and worship them, and do not provoke Me to anger with the works of your hands. Then I will do you no harm.’
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: ‘But to your own harm, you have not listened to Me,’ declares the LORD, ‘so you have provoked Me to anger with the works of your hands.’
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: Therefore this is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘Because you have not obeyed My words,
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: behold, I will summon all the families of the north, declares the LORD, and I will send for My servant Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, whom I will bring against this land, against its residents, and against all the surrounding nations. So I will devote them to destruction and make them an object of horror and contempt, an everlasting desolation.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: Moreover, I will banish from them the sounds of joy and gladness, the voices of the bride and bridegroom, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the lamp.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: And this whole land will become a desolate wasteland, and these nations will serve the king of Babylon for seventy years.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: But when seventy years are complete, I will punish the king of Babylon and that nation, the land of the Chaldeans, for their guilt, declares the LORD, and I will make it an everlasting desolation.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: I will bring upon that land all the words I have pronounced against it, all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah has prophesied against all the nations.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: For many nations and great kings will enslave them, and I will repay them according to their deeds and according to the work of their hands.’
name: Jeremiah

speaker: god
text: Take from My hand this cup of the wine of wrath, and make all the nations to whom I send you drink from it.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And they will drink and stagger and go out of their minds, because of the sword that I will send among them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then you are to tell them that this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘Drink, get drunk, and vomit. Fall down and never get up again, because of the sword I will send among you.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: If they refuse to take the cup from your hand and drink it, you are to tell them that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘You most certainly must drink it!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For behold, I am beginning to bring disaster on the city that bears My Name, so how could you possibly go unpunished? You will not go unpunished, for I am calling down a sword upon all the inhabitants of the earth, declares the LORD of Hosts.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So you are to prophesy all these words against them and say to them: ‘The LORD will roar from on high; He will raise His voice from His holy habitation. He will roar loudly over His pasture; like those who tread the grapes, He will call out with a shout against all the inhabitants of the earth.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The tumult will resound to the ends of the earth because the LORD brings a charge against the nations. He brings judgment on all mankind and puts the wicked to the sword,’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold! Disaster is spreading from nation to nation; a mighty storm is rising from the ends of the earth.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: This is what the LORD says: Stand in the courtyard of the house of the LORD and speak all the words I have commanded you to speak to all the cities of Judah who come to worship there. Do not omit a word.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Perhaps they will listen and turn—each from his evil way of life—so that I may relent of the disaster I am planning to bring upon them because of the evil of their deeds.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And you are to tell them that this is what the LORD says: ‘If you do not listen to Me and walk in My law, which I have set before you,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: and if you do not listen to the words of My servants the prophets, whom I have sent you again and again even though you did not listen,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: then I will make this house like Shiloh, and I will make this city an object of cursing among all the nations of the earth.’
name: The LORD

speaker: priests-prophets
text: You must surely die!
name: The priests and prophets

speaker: priests-prophets
text: How dare you prophesy in the name of the LORD that this house will become like Shiloh and this city will be desolate and deserted!
name: The priests and prophets

speaker: priests-prophets
text: This man is worthy of death, for he has prophesied against this city, as you have heard with your own ears!
name: The priests and prophets

speaker: jeremiah
text: The LORD sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that you have heard.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: So now, correct your ways and deeds, and obey the voice of the LORD your God, so that He might relent of the disaster He has pronounced against you.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: As for me, here I am in your hands; do to me what you think is good and right.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: But know for certain that if you put me to death, you will bring innocent blood upon yourselves, upon this city, and upon its residents; for truly the LORD has sent me to speak all these words in your hearing.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: officials
text: This man is not worthy of death, for he has spoken to us in the name of the LORD our God!
name: The officials and the people

speaker: elders
text: Micah the Moreshite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah and told all the people of Judah that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘Zion will be plowed like a field, Jerusalem will become a heap of rubble, and the temple mount a wooded ridge.’
name: The elders of the land

speaker: elders
text: Did Hezekiah king of Judah or anyone else in Judah put him to death? Did Hezekiah not fear the LORD and seek His favor, and did not the LORD relent of the disaster He had pronounced against them? But we are about to bring great harm on ourselves!
name: The elders of the land

speaker: god
text: Make for yourself a yoke out of leather straps and put it on your neck.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Send word to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon, Tyre, and Sidon through the envoys who have come to Jerusalem to Zedekiah king of Judah.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Give them a message from the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, to relay to their masters:
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: By My great power and outstretched arm, I made the earth and the men and beasts on the face of it, and I give it to whom I please.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So now I have placed all these lands under the authority of My servant Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon. I have even made the beasts of the field subject to him.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: All nations will serve him and his son and grandson, until the time of his own land comes; then many nations and great kings will enslave him.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: As for the nation or kingdom that does not serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and does not place its neck under his yoke, I will punish that nation by sword and famine and plague, declares the LORD, until I have destroyed it by his hand.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But as for you, do not listen to your prophets, your diviners, your interpreters of dreams, your mediums, or your sorcerers who declare, ‘You will not serve the king of Babylon.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For they prophesy to you a lie that will serve to remove you from your land; I will banish you and you will perish.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But the nation that will put its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon and serve him, I will leave in its own land, to cultivate it and reside in it, declares the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: jeremiah
text: Put your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon; serve him and his people, and live!
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: Why should you and your people die by sword and famine and plague, as the LORD has decreed against any nation that does not serve the king of Babylon?
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: Do not listen to the words of the prophets who say, ‘You must not serve the king of Babylon,’ for they are prophesying to you a lie.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: For I have not sent them, declares the LORD, and yet they are prophesying falsely in My name; therefore I will banish you, and you will perish—you and the prophets who prophesy to you.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: This is what the LORD says: Do not listen to the words of your prophets who prophesy to you, saying, ‘Look, very soon now the articles from the house of the LORD will be brought back from Babylon.’ They are prophesying to you a lie.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: Do not listen to them. Serve the king of Babylon and live! Why should this city become a ruin?
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: If they are indeed prophets and the word of the LORD is with them, let them now plead with the LORD of Hosts that the articles remaining in the house of the LORD, in the palace of the king of Judah, and in Jerusalem, not be taken to Babylon.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: For this is what the LORD of Hosts says about the pillars, the sea, the bases, and the rest of the articles that remain in this city,
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon did not take when he carried Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim king of Judah into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon, along with all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: Yes, this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says about the articles that remain in the house of the LORD, in the palace of the king of Judah, and in Jerusalem:
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: ‘They will be carried to Babylon and will remain there until the day I attend to them again,’ declares the LORD. ‘Then I will bring them back and restore them to this place.’
name: Jeremiah

speaker: hananiah
text: This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.
name: Hananiah the prophet

speaker: hananiah
text: Within two years I will restore to this place all the articles of the house of the LORD that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon removed from here and carried to Babylon.
name: Hananiah the prophet

speaker: hananiah
text: And I will restore to this place Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, along with all the exiles from Judah who went to Babylon,’ declares the LORD, ‘for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.’
name: Hananiah the prophet

speaker: jeremiah
text: Amen!
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: May the LORD do so! May the LORD fulfill the words you have prophesied, and may He restore the articles of His house and all the exiles back to this place from Babylon.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: Nevertheless, listen now to this message I am speaking in your hearing and in the hearing of all the people.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: The prophets of old who preceded you and me prophesied war, disaster, and plague against many lands and great kingdoms.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: As for the prophet who prophesies peace, only if the word of the prophet comes true will the prophet be recognized as one the LORD has truly sent.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: hananiah
text: This is what the LORD says: ‘In this way, within two years I will break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon off the neck of all the nations.’
name: Hananiah the prophet

speaker: god
text: Go and tell Hananiah that this is what the LORD says: ‘You have broken a yoke of wood, but in its place you have fashioned a yoke of iron.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘I have put a yoke of iron on the neck of all these nations to make them serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and they will serve him. I have even given him control of the beasts of the field.’
name: The LORD

speaker: jeremiah
text: Listen, Hananiah! The LORD did not send you, but you have persuaded this people to trust in a lie.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: Therefore this is what the LORD says: ‘I am about to remove you from the face of the earth. You will die this year because you have preached rebellion against the LORD.’
name: Jeremiah

speaker: god
text: Build houses and settle down. Plant gardens and eat their produce.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Take wives and have sons and daughters. Take wives for your sons and give your daughters in marriage, so that they too may have sons and daughters. Multiply there; do not decrease.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Seek the prosperity of the city to which I have sent you as exiles. Pray to the LORD on its behalf, for if it prospers, you too will prosper.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Do not be deceived by the prophets and diviners among you, and do not listen to the dreams you elicit from them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For they are falsely prophesying to you in My name; I have not sent them, declares the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: When Babylon’s seventy years are complete, I will attend to you and confirm My promise to restore you to this place.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For I know the plans I have for you, declares the LORD, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, to give you a future and a hope.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then you will call upon Me and come and pray to Me, and I will listen to you.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You will seek Me and find Me when you search for Me with all your heart.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will be found by you, declares the LORD, and I will restore you from captivity and gather you from all the nations and places to which I have banished you, declares the LORD. I will restore you to the place from which I sent you into exile.
name: The LORD

speaker: exiles
text: The LORD has raised up for us prophets in Babylon,
name: The exiles

speaker: god
text: I will send against them sword and famine and plague, and I will make them like rotten figs, so bad they cannot be eaten.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will pursue them with sword and famine and plague. I will make them a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth—a curse, a desolation, and an object of scorn and reproach among all the nations to which I banish them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will do this because they have not listened to My words, declares the LORD, which I sent to them again and again through My servants the prophets. And neither have you exiles listened, declares the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will deliver them to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will kill them before your very eyes.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Because of them, all the exiles of Judah who are in Babylon will use this curse: ‘May the LORD make you like Zedekiah and Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire!’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For they have committed an outrage in Israel by committing adultery with the wives of their neighbors and speaking lies in My name, which I did not command them to do. I am He who knows, and I am a witness, declares the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: In your own name you have sent out letters to all the people of Jerusalem, to the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah, and to all the priests. You said to Zephaniah:
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: ‘The LORD has appointed you priest in place of Jehoiada, to be the chief officer in the house of the LORD, responsible for any madman who acts like a prophet—you must put him in stocks and neck irons.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So now, why have you not rebuked Jeremiah of Anathoth, who poses as a prophet among you?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For he has sent to us in Babylon, claiming: Since the exile will be lengthy, build houses and settle down; plant gardens and eat their produce.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Send a message telling all the exiles what the LORD says concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite. Because Shemaiah has prophesied to you—though I did not send him—and has made you trust in a lie,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: this is what the LORD says: ‘I will surely punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite and his descendants. He will have no one left among this people, nor will he see the good that I will bring to My people, declares the LORD, for he has preached rebellion against the LORD.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Write in a book all the words that I have spoken to you.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when I will restore from captivity My people Israel and Judah, declares the LORD. I will restore them to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they will possess it.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: A cry of panic is heard— a cry of terror, not of peace.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Ask now, and see: Can a male give birth? Why then do I see every man with his hands on his stomach like a woman in labor and every face turned pale?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: How awful that day will be! None will be like it! It is the time of Jacob’s distress, but he will be saved out of it.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: On that day, declares the LORD of Hosts, I will break the yoke off their necks and tear off their bonds, and no longer will strangers enslave them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Instead, they will serve the LORD their God and David their king, whom I will raise up for them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: As for you, O Jacob My servant, do not be afraid, declares the LORD, and do not be dismayed, O Israel. For I will surely save you out of a distant place, your descendants from the land of their captivity! Jacob will return to quiet and ease, with no one to make him afraid.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For I am with you to save you, declares the LORD. Though I will completely destroy all the nations to which I have scattered you, I will not completely destroy you. Yet I will discipline you justly, and will by no means leave you unpunished.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Your injury is incurable; your wound is grievous.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: There is no one to plead your cause, no remedy for your sores, no recovery for you.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: All your lovers have forgotten you; they no longer seek you, for I have struck you as an enemy would, with the discipline of someone cruel, because of your great iniquity and your numerous sins.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Why do you cry out over your wound? Your pain has no cure! Because of your great iniquity and your numerous sins I have done these things to you.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Nevertheless, all who devour you will be devoured, and all your adversaries—every one of them— will go off into exile. Those who plundered you will be plundered, and all who raided you will be raided.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But I will restore your health and heal your wounds, declares the LORD, because they call you an outcast, Zion, for whom no one cares.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will restore the fortunes of Jacob’s tents and have compassion on his dwellings. And the city will be rebuilt on her own ruins, and the palace will stand in its rightful place.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Thanksgiving will proceed from them, a sound of celebration. I will multiply them, and they will not be decreased; I will honor them, and they will not be belittled.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Their children will be as in days of old, and their congregation will be established before Me; and I will punish all their oppressors.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Their leader will be one of their own, and their ruler will arise from their midst. And I will bring him near, and he will approach Me, for who would dare on his own to approach Me?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And you will be My people, and I will be your God.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: At that time,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they will be My people.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The people who survived the sword found favor in the wilderness when Israel went to find rest.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I have loved you with an everlasting love; therefore I have drawn you with loving devotion.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Again I will build you, and you will be rebuilt, O Virgin Israel. Again you will take up your tambourines and go out in joyful dancing.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Again you will plant vineyards on the hills of Samaria; the farmers will plant and enjoy the fruit.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For there will be a day when watchmen will call out on the hills of Ephraim, ‘Arise, let us go up to Zion, to the LORD our God!’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Sing with joy for Jacob; shout for the foremost of the nations! Make your praises heard, and say, ‘O LORD, save Your people, the remnant of Israel!’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, I will bring them from the land of the north and gather them from the farthest parts of the earth, including the blind and the lame, expectant mothers and women in labor. They will return as a great assembly!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They will come with weeping, and by their supplication I will lead them; I will make them walk beside streams of waters, on a level path where they will not stumble. For I am Israel’s Father, and Ephraim is My firstborn.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The One who scattered Israel will gather them and keep them as a shepherd keeps his flock.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For the LORD has ransomed Jacob and redeemed him from the hand that had overpowered him.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They will come and shout for joy on the heights of Zion; they will be radiant over the bounty of the LORD— the grain, new wine, and oil, and the young of the flocks and herds. Their life will be like a well-watered garden, and never again will they languish.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then the maidens will rejoice with dancing, young men and old as well. I will turn their mourning into joy, and give them comfort and joy for their sorrow.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will fill the souls of the priests abundantly, and will fill My people with My goodness,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: A voice is heard in Ramah, mourning and great weeping, Rachel weeping for her children, and refusing to be comforted, because they are no more.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Keep your voice from weeping and your eyes from tears, for the reward for your work will come, declares the LORD. Then your children will return from the land of the enemy.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So there is hope for your future, declares the LORD, and your children will return to their own land.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I have surely heard Ephraim’s moaning: ‘You disciplined me severely, like an untrained calf. Restore me, that I may return, for You are the LORD my God.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: After I returned, I repented; and after I was instructed, I struck my thigh in grief. I was ashamed and humiliated because I bore the disgrace of my youth.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Is not Ephraim a precious son to Me, a delightful child? Though I often speak against him, I still remember him. Therefore My heart yearns for him; I have great compassion for him,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Set up the roadmarks, establish the signposts. Keep the highway in mind, the road you have traveled. Return, O Virgin Israel, return to these cities of yours.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: How long will you wander, O faithless daughter? For the LORD has created a new thing in the land— a woman will shelter a man.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: When I restore them from captivity, they will once again speak this word in the land of Judah and in its cities: ‘May the LORD bless you, O righteous dwelling place, O holy mountain.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And Judah and all its cities will dwell together in the land, the farmers and those who move with the flocks,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: for I will refresh the weary soul and replenish all who are weak.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The days are coming,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: when I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man and of beast.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Just as I watched over them to uproot and tear down, to demolish, destroy, and bring disaster, so I will watch over them to build and to plant,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: In those days, it will no longer be said: ‘The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the teeth of the children are set on edge.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Instead, each will die for his own iniquity. If anyone eats the sour grapes, his own teeth will be set on edge.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: It will not be like the covenant I made with their fathers when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt— a covenant they broke, though I was a husband to them,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But this is the covenant I will make with the house of Israel after those days, declares the LORD. I will put My law in their minds and inscribe it on their hearts. And I will be their God, and they will be My people.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: No longer will each man teach his neighbor or his brother, saying, ‘Know the LORD,’ because they will all know Me, from the least of them to the greatest, declares the LORD. For I will forgive their iniquities and will remember their sins no more.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Only if this fixed order departed from My presence, declares the LORD, would Israel’s descendants ever cease to be a nation before Me.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Only if the heavens above could be measured and the foundations of the earth below searched out would I reject all of Israel’s descendants because of all they have done,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The days are coming,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: when this city will be rebuilt for Me, from the tower of Hananel to the Corner Gate.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The measuring line will once again stretch out straight to the hill of Gareb and then turn toward Goah.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The whole valley of the dead bodies and ashes, and all the fields as far as the Kidron Valley, to the corner of the Horse Gate to the east, will be holy to the LORD. It will never again be uprooted or demolished.
name: The LORD

speaker: zedekiah
text: Why are you prophesying like this? You claim that the LORD says, ‘Behold, I am about to deliver this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will capture it.
name: King Zedekiah

speaker: zedekiah
text: Zedekiah king of Judah will not escape from the hands of the Chaldeans, but he will surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, and will speak with him face to face and see him eye to eye.
name: King Zedekiah

speaker: zedekiah
text: He will take Zedekiah to Babylon, where he will stay until I attend to him, declares the LORD. If you fight against the Chaldeans, you will not succeed.’
name: King Zedekiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: The word of the LORD came to me, saying:
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: Behold! Hanamel, the son of your uncle Shallum, is coming to you to say, ‘Buy for yourself my field in Anathoth, for you have the right of redemption to buy it.’
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: Then, as the LORD had said, my cousin Hanamel came to me in the courtyard of the guard and urged me, ‘Please buy my field in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin, for you own the right of inheritance and redemption. Buy it for yourself.’
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: Take these deeds—both the sealed copy and the open copy of the deed of purchase—and put them in a clay jar to preserve them for a long time.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: For this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: Houses, fields, and vineyards will again be bought in this land.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: Oh, Lord GOD! You have made the heavens and the earth by Your great power and outstretched arm. Nothing is too difficult for You!
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: You show loving devotion to thousands but lay the iniquity of the fathers into the laps of their children after them, O great and mighty God whose name is the LORD of Hosts,
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: the One great in counsel and mighty in deed, whose eyes are on all the ways of the sons of men, to reward each one according to his ways and according to the fruit of his deeds.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: You performed signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, and You do so to this very day, both in Israel and among all mankind. And You have made a name for Yourself, as is the case to this day.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: You brought Your people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs and wonders, with a strong hand and an outstretched arm, and with great terror.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: You gave them this land that You had sworn to give their fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: They came in and possessed it, but they did not obey Your voice or walk in Your law. They failed to perform all that You commanded them to do, and so You have brought upon them all this disaster.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: See how the siege ramps are mounted against the city to capture it. And by sword and famine and plague, the city has been given into the hands of the Chaldeans who are fighting against it. What You have spoken has happened, as You now see!
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: Yet You, O Lord GOD, have said to me, ‘Buy for yourself the field with silver and call in witnesses, even though the city has been delivered into the hands of the Chaldeans!’
name: Jeremiah

speaker: god
text: Behold, I am the LORD, the God of all flesh. Is anything too difficult for Me?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore this is what the LORD says: Behold, I am about to deliver this city into the hands of the Chaldeans and of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, who will capture it.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And the Chaldeans who are fighting against this city will come in, set it on fire, and burn it, along with the houses of those who provoked Me to anger by burning incense to Baal on their rooftops and by pouring out drink offerings to other gods.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For the children of Israel and of Judah have done nothing but evil in My sight from their youth; indeed, they have done nothing but provoke Me to anger by the work of their hands, declares the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For this city has aroused My wrath and fury from the day it was built until now. Therefore I will remove it from My presence
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: because of all the evil the children of Israel and of Judah have done to provoke Me to anger—they, their kings, their officials, their priests and prophets, the men of Judah, and the residents of Jerusalem.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They have turned their backs to Me and not their faces. Though I taught them again and again, they would not listen or respond to discipline.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They have placed their abominations in the house that bears My Name, and so have defiled it.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They have built the high places of Baal in the Valley of Hinnom to make their sons and daughters pass through the fire to Molech—something I never commanded them, nor had it ever entered My mind, that they should commit such an abomination and cause Judah to sin.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Now therefore, about this city of which you say, ‘It will be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon by sword and famine and plague,’ this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says:
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will surely gather My people from all the lands to which I have banished them in My furious anger and great wrath, and I will return them to this place and make them dwell in safety.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They will be My people, and I will be their God.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will give them one heart and one way, so that they will always fear Me for their own good and for the good of their children after them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will make an everlasting covenant with them: I will never turn away from doing good to them, and I will put My fear in their hearts, so that they will never turn away from Me.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Yes, I will rejoice in doing them good, and I will faithfully plant them in this land with all My heart and with all My soul.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For this is what the LORD says: Just as I have brought all this great disaster on this people, so I will bring on them all the good I have promised them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And fields will be bought in this land about which you are saying, ‘It is a desolation, without man or beast; it has been delivered into the hands of the Chaldeans.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Fields will be purchased with silver, and deeds will be signed, sealed, and witnessed in the land of Benjamin, in the areas surrounding Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah—the cities of the hill country, the foothills, and the Negev—because I will restore them from captivity, declares the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Thus says the LORD who made the earth, the LORD who formed it and established it, the LORD is His name:
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Call to Me, and I will answer and show you great and unsearchable things you do not know.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says about the houses of this city and the palaces of the kings of Judah that have been torn down for defense against the siege ramps and the sword:
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The Chaldeans are coming to fight and to fill those places with the corpses of the men I will strike down in My anger and in My wrath. I have hidden My face from this city because of all its wickedness.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Nevertheless, I will bring to it health and healing, and I will heal its people and reveal to them the abundance of peace and truth.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will restore Judah and Israel from captivity and will rebuild them as in former times.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And I will cleanse them from all the iniquity they have committed against Me, and will forgive all their sins of rebellion against Me.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So this city will bring Me renown, joy, praise, and glory before all the nations of the earth, who will hear of all the good I do for it. They will tremble in awe because of all the goodness and prosperity that I will provide for it.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: This is what the LORD says: In this place you say is a wasteland without man or beast, in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem that are deserted—inhabited by neither man nor beast—there will be heard again
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: the sounds of joy and gladness, the voices of the bride and bridegroom, and the voices of those bringing thank offerings into the house of the LORD, saying: ‘Give thanks to the LORD of Hosts, for the LORD is good; His loving devotion endures forever.’ For I will restore the land from captivity as in former times, says the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: This is what the LORD of Hosts says: In this desolate place, without man or beast, and in all its cities, there will once more be pastures for shepherds to rest their flocks.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: In the cities of the hill country, the foothills, and the Negev, in the land of Benjamin and the cities surrounding Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, the flocks will again pass under the hands of the one who counts them, says the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when I will fulfill the gracious promise that I have spoken to the house of Israel and the house of Judah.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: In those days and at that time I will cause to sprout for David a righteous Branch, and He will administer justice and righteousness in the land.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: In those days Judah will be saved, and Jerusalem will dwell securely, and this is the name by which it will be called: The LORD Our Righteousness.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For this is what the LORD says: David will never lack a man to sit on the throne of the house of Israel,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: nor will the priests who are Levites ever fail to have a man before Me to offer burnt offerings, to burn grain offerings, and to present sacrifices.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: This is what the LORD says: If you can break My covenant with the day and My covenant with the night, so that day and night cease to occupy their appointed time,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: then My covenant may also be broken with David My servant and with My ministers the Levites who are priests, so that David will not have a son to reign on his throne.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: As the hosts of heaven cannot be counted and as the sand on the seashore cannot be measured, so too will I multiply the descendants of My servant David and the Levites who minister before Me.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Have you not noticed what these people are saying: ‘The LORD has rejected the two families He had chosen’? So they despise My people and no longer regard them as a nation.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: This is what the LORD says: If I have not established My covenant with the day and the night and the fixed order of heaven and earth,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: then I would also reject the descendants of Jacob and of My servant David, so as not to take from his descendants rulers over the descendants of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. For I will restore them from captivity and will have compassion on them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, I am about to deliver this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will burn it down.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And you yourself will not escape his grasp, but will surely be captured and delivered into his hand. You will see the king of Babylon eye to eye and speak with him face to face; and you will go to Babylon.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Yet hear the word of the LORD, O Zedekiah king of Judah. This is what the LORD says concerning you: You will not die by the sword;
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: you will die in peace. As spices were burned for your fathers, the former kings who preceded you, so people will burn spices for you and lament, ‘Alas, O master!’ For I Myself have spoken this word, declares the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: I made a covenant with your forefathers when I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery, saying:
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Every seventh year, each of you must free his Hebrew brother who has sold himself to you. He may serve you six years, but then you must let him go free. But your fathers did not listen or incline their ear.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Recently you repented and did what pleased Me; each of you proclaimed freedom for his neighbor. You made a covenant before Me in the house that bears My Name.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But now you have changed your minds and profaned My name. Each of you has taken back the menservants and maidservants whom you had set at liberty to go wherever they wanted, and you have again forced them to be your slaves.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore this is what the LORD says: You have not obeyed Me; you have not proclaimed freedom, each man for his brother and for his neighbor. So now I proclaim freedom for you, declares the LORD—freedom to fall by sword, by plague, and by famine! I will make you a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And those who have transgressed My covenant and have not fulfilled the terms of the covenant they made before Me, I will treat like the calf they cut in two in order to pass between its pieces.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The officials of Judah and Jerusalem, the court officials, the priests, and all the people of the land who passed between the pieces of the calf,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will deliver into the hands of their enemies who seek their lives. Their corpses will become food for the birds of the air and the beasts of the earth.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah and his officials into the hands of their enemies who seek their lives, to the army of the king of Babylon that had withdrawn from you.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, I am going to give the command, declares the LORD, and I will bring them back to this city. They will fight against it, capture it, and burn it down. And I will make the cities of Judah a desolation, without inhabitant.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Go to the house of the Rechabites, speak to them, and bring them to one of the chambers of the house of the LORD to offer them a drink of wine.
name: The LORD

speaker: jeremiah
text: Drink some wine.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: rechabites
text: We do not drink wine,
name: The Rechabites

speaker: rechabites
text: for our forefather Jonadab son of Rechab commanded us, ‘Neither you nor your descendants are ever to drink wine.
name: The Rechabites

speaker: rechabites
text: Nor are you ever to build a house or sow seed or plant a vineyard. Those things are not for you. Instead, you must live in tents all your lives, so that you may live a long time in the land where you wander.’
name: The Rechabites

speaker: rechabites
text: And we have obeyed the voice of our forefather Jonadab son of Rechab in all he commanded us. So we have not drunk wine all our lives—neither we nor our wives nor our sons and daughters.
name: The Rechabites

speaker: rechabites
text: Nor have we built houses in which to live, and we have not owned any vineyards or fields or crops.
name: The Rechabites

speaker: rechabites
text: But we have lived in tents and have obeyed and done exactly as our forefather Jonadab commanded us.
name: The Rechabites

speaker: rechabites
text: So when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon marched into the land, we said: ‘Come, let us go into Jerusalem to escape the armies of the Chaldeans and the Arameans.’ So we have remained in Jerusalem.
name: The Rechabites

speaker: god
text: This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: Go and tell the men of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem: ‘Will you not accept discipline and obey My words?’ declares the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The words of Jonadab son of Rechab have been carried out. He commanded his sons not to drink wine, and they have not drunk it to this very day because they have obeyed the command of their forefather. But I have spoken to you again and again, and you have not obeyed Me!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Again and again I have sent you all My servants the prophets, proclaiming: ‘Turn now, each of you, from your wicked ways, and correct your actions. Do not go after other gods to serve them. Live in the land that I have given to you and your fathers.’ But you have not inclined your ear or listened to Me.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Yes, the sons of Jonadab son of Rechab carried out the command their forefather gave them, but these people have not listened to Me.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore this is what the LORD God of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘Behold, I will bring to Judah and to all the residents of Jerusalem all the disaster I have pronounced against them, because I have spoken to them but they have not obeyed, and I have called to them but they have not answered.’
name: The LORD

speaker: jeremiah
text: This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘Because you have obeyed the command of your forefather Jonadab and have kept all his commandments and have done all that he charged you to do,
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: Jonadab son of Rechab will never fail to have a man to stand before Me.’
name: Jeremiah

speaker: god
text: Take a scroll and write on it all the words I have spoken to you concerning Israel, Judah, and all the nations, from the day I first spoke to you during the reign of Josiah until today.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Perhaps when the people of Judah hear about all the calamity I plan to bring upon them, each of them will turn from his wicked way. Then I will forgive their iniquity and their sin.
name: The LORD

speaker: jeremiah
text: I am restricted; I cannot enter the house of the LORD;
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: so you are to go to the house of the LORD on a day of fasting, and in the hearing of the people you are to read the words of the LORD from the scroll you have written at my dictation. Read them in the hearing of all the people of Judah who are coming from their cities.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: Perhaps they will bring their petition before the LORD, and each one will turn from his wicked way; for great are the anger and fury that the LORD has pronounced against this people.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jehudi-officials
text: Bring the scroll that you read in the hearing of the people, and come here.
name: The officials

speaker: jehudi-officials
text: Please sit down,
name: The officials

speaker: jehudi-officials
text: and read it in our hearing.
name: The officials

speaker: jehudi-officials
text: Surely we must report all these words to the king.
name: The officials

speaker: jehudi-officials
text: Tell us now,
name: The officials

speaker: jehudi-officials
text: how did you write all these words? Was it at Jeremiah’s dictation?
name: The officials

speaker: baruch
text: It was at his dictation,
name: Baruch

speaker: baruch
text: He recited all these words to me and I wrote them in ink on the scroll.
name: Baruch

speaker: jehudi-officials
text: You and Jeremiah must hide yourselves and tell no one where you are.
name: The officials

speaker: god
text: Take another scroll and rewrite on it the very words that were on the original scroll, which Jehoiakim king of Judah has burned.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You are to proclaim concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah that this is what the LORD says: You have burned the scroll and said, ‘Why have you written on it that the king of Babylon would surely come and destroy this land and deprive it of man and beast?’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore this is what the LORD says about Jehoiakim king of Judah: He will have no one to sit on David’s throne, and his body will be thrown out and exposed to heat by day and frost by night.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will punish him and his descendants and servants for their iniquity. I will bring on them, on the residents of Jerusalem, and on the men of Judah, all the calamity about which I warned them but they did not listen.
name: The LORD

speaker: zedekiah-envoys
text: Please pray to the LORD our God for us!
name: Zedekiah's envoys

speaker: god
text: This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says that you are to tell the king of Judah, who sent you to Me: Behold, Pharaoh’s army, which has marched out to help you, will go back to its own land of Egypt.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then the Chaldeans will return and fight against this city. They will capture it and burn it down.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: This is what the LORD says: Do not deceive yourselves by saying, ‘The Chaldeans will go away for good,’ for they will not!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Indeed, if you were to strike down the entire army of the Chaldeans that is fighting against you, and only wounded men remained in their tents, they would still get up and burn this city down.
name: The LORD

speaker: irijah
text: You are deserting to the Chaldeans!
name: Irijah the captain

speaker: jeremiah
text: That is a lie,
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: I am not deserting to the Chaldeans!
name: Jeremiah

speaker: zedekiah
text: Is there a word from the LORD?
name: King Zedekiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: There is,
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: You will be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: How have I sinned against you or your servants or these people, that you have put me in prison?
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: Where are your prophets who prophesied to you, claiming, ‘The king of Babylon will not come against you or this land’?
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: But now please listen, O my lord the king. May my petition come before you. Do not send me back to the house of Jonathan the scribe, or I will die there.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: This is what the LORD says: Whoever stays in this city will die by sword and famine and plague, but whoever surrenders to the Chaldeans will live; he will retain his life like a spoil of war, and he will live.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: This is what the LORD says: This city will surely be delivered into the hands of the army of the king of Babylon, and he will capture it.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jehudi-officials
text: This man ought to die, for he is discouraging the warriors who remain in this city, as well as all the people, by speaking such words to them; this man is not seeking the well-being of these people, but their ruin.
name: The officials

speaker: zedekiah
text: Here he is,
name: King Zedekiah

speaker: zedekiah
text: He is in your hands, since the king can do nothing to stop you.
name: King Zedekiah

speaker: ebed-melech
text: My lord the king, these men have acted wickedly in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet. They have dropped him into the cistern, where he will starve to death, for there is no more bread in the city.
name: Ebed-melech the Cushite

speaker: zedekiah
text: Take thirty men from here with you and pull Jeremiah the prophet out of the cistern before he dies.
name: King Zedekiah

speaker: ebed-melech
text: Put these worn-out rags and clothes under your arms to pad the ropes.
name: Ebed-melech the Cushite

speaker: zedekiah
text: I am going to ask you something,
name: King Zedekiah

speaker: zedekiah
text: Do not hide anything from me.
name: King Zedekiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: If I tell you,
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: you will surely put me to death. And even if I give you advice, you will not listen to me.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: zedekiah
text: As surely as the LORD lives, who has given us this life, I will not kill you, nor will I deliver you into the hands of these men who are seeking your life.
name: King Zedekiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: This is what the LORD God of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘If you indeed surrender to the officers of the king of Babylon, then you will live, this city will not be burned down, and you and your household will survive.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: But if you do not surrender to the officers of the king of Babylon, then this city will be delivered into the hands of the Chaldeans. They will burn it down, and you yourself will not escape their grasp.’
name: Jeremiah

speaker: zedekiah
text: I am afraid of the Jews who have deserted to the Chaldeans, for the Chaldeans may deliver me into their hands to abuse me.
name: King Zedekiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: They will not hand you over,
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: Obey the voice of the LORD in what I am telling you, that it may go well with you and you may live.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: But if you refuse to surrender, this is the word that the LORD has shown me:
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: All the women who remain in the palace of the king of Judah will be brought out to the officials of the king of Babylon, and those women will say: ‘They misled you and overcame you— those trusted friends of yours. Your feet sank into the mire, and they deserted you.’
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: All your wives and children will be brought out to the Chaldeans. And you yourself will not escape their grasp, for you will be seized by the king of Babylon, and this city will be burned down.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: zedekiah
text: Do not let anyone know about this conversation, or you will die.
name: King Zedekiah

speaker: zedekiah
text: If the officials hear that I have spoken with you, and they come and demand of you, ‘Tell us what you said to the king and what he said to you; do not hide it from us, or we will kill you,’
name: King Zedekiah

speaker: zedekiah
text: then tell them, ‘I was presenting to the king my petition that he not return me to the house of Jonathan to die there.’
name: King Zedekiah

speaker: nebuchadnezzar
text: Take him, look after him, and do not let any harm come to him; do for him whatever he says.
name: Nebuchadnezzar

speaker: god
text: Go and tell Ebed-melech the Cushite that this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘I am about to fulfill My words against this city for harm and not for good, and on that day they will be fulfilled before your eyes.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But I will deliver you on that day, declares the LORD, and you will not be delivered into the hands of the men whom you fear.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For I will surely rescue you so that you do not fall by the sword. Because you have trusted in Me, you will escape with your life like a spoil of war, declares the LORD.’
name: The LORD

speaker: nebuzaradan
text: The LORD your God decreed this disaster on this place,
name: Nebuzaradan

speaker: nebuzaradan
text: and now the LORD has fulfilled it; He has done just as He said. Because you people have sinned against the LORD and have not obeyed His voice, this thing has happened to you.
name: Nebuzaradan

speaker: nebuzaradan
text: But now, behold, I am freeing you today from the chains that were on your wrists. If it pleases you to come with me to Babylon, then come, and I will take care of you. But if it seems wrong to you to come with me to Babylon, go no farther. Look, the whole land is before you. Wherever it seems good and right to you, go there.
name: Nebuzaradan

speaker: nebuzaradan
text: Return to Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, whom the king of Babylon has appointed over the cities of Judah, and stay with him among the people, or go anywhere else that seems right.
name: Nebuzaradan

speaker: gedaliah
text: Do not be afraid to serve the Chaldeans. Live in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will go well with you.
name: Gedaliah

speaker: gedaliah
text: As for me, I will stay in Mizpah to represent you before the Chaldeans who come to us. As for you, gather wine grapes, summer fruit, and oil, place them in your storage jars, and live in the cities you have taken.
name: Gedaliah

speaker: johanan
text: Are you aware that Baalis king of the Ammonites has sent Ishmael son of Nethaniah to take your life?
name: Johanan son of Kareah

speaker: johanan
text: Let me go and kill Ishmael son of Nethaniah,
name: Johanan son of Kareah

speaker: johanan
text: No one will know it. Why should he take your life and scatter all the people of Judah who have gathered to you, so that the remnant of Judah would perish?
name: Johanan son of Kareah

speaker: gedaliah
text: Do not do such a thing! What you are saying about Ishmael is a lie.
name: Gedaliah

speaker: ishmael
text: Come to Gedaliah son of Ahikam.
name: Ishmael

speaker: ten-men
text: Do not kill us, for we have hidden treasure in the field—wheat, barley, oil, and honey!
name: Ten of the men

speaker: remnant
text: May our petition come before you; pray to the LORD your God on behalf of this entire remnant. For few of us remain of the many, as you can see with your own eyes.
name: The remnant of Judah

speaker: remnant
text: Pray that the LORD your God will tell us the way we should walk and the thing we should do.
name: The remnant of Judah

speaker: jeremiah
text: I have heard you,
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: I will surely pray to the LORD your God as you request, and I will tell you everything that the LORD answers; I will not withhold a word from you.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: remnant
text: May the LORD be a true and faithful witness against us if we do not act upon every word that the LORD your God sends you to tell us.
name: The remnant of Judah

speaker: remnant
text: Whether it is pleasant or unpleasant, we will obey the voice of the LORD our God to whom we are sending you, so that it may go well with us, for we will obey the voice of the LORD our God!
name: The remnant of Judah

speaker: jeremiah
text: Thus says the LORD, the God of Israel, to whom you sent me to present your petition:
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: ‘If you will indeed stay in this land, then I will build you up and not tear you down; I will plant you and not uproot you, for I will relent of the disaster I have brought upon you.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: Do not be afraid of the king of Babylon, whom you now fear; do not be afraid of him, declares the LORD, for I am with you to save you and deliver you from him.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: And I will show you compassion, and he will have compassion on you and restore you to your own land.’
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: But if you say, ‘We will not stay in this land,’ and you thus disobey the voice of the LORD your God,
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: and if you say, ‘No, but we will go to the land of Egypt and live there, where we will not see war or hear the sound of the ram’s horn or hunger for bread,’
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: then hear the word of the LORD, O remnant of Judah! This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘If you are determined to go to Egypt and reside there,
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: then the sword you fear will overtake you there, and the famine you dread will follow on your heels into Egypt, and you will die there.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: So all who resolve to go to Egypt to reside there will die by sword and famine and plague. Not one of them will survive or escape the disaster I will bring upon them.’
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: For this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘Just as My anger and wrath were poured out on the residents of Jerusalem, so will My wrath be poured out on you if you go to Egypt. You will become an object of cursing and horror, of vilification and disgrace, and you will never see this place again.’
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: The LORD has told you, O remnant of Judah, ‘Do not go to Egypt.’ Know for sure that I have warned you today!
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: For you have deceived yourselves by sending me to the LORD your God, saying, ‘Pray to the LORD our God on our behalf, and as for all that the LORD our God says, tell it to us and we will do it.’
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: For I have told you today, but you have not obeyed the voice of the LORD your God in all He has sent me to tell you.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: Now therefore, know for sure that by sword and famine and plague you will die in the place where you desire to go to reside.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: arrogant-men
text: You are lying! The LORD our God has not sent you to say, ‘You must not go to Egypt to reside there.’
name: Azariah, Johanan and the arrogant men

speaker: arrogant-men
text: Rather, Baruch son of Neriah is inciting you against us to deliver us into the hands of the Chaldeans, so that they may put us to death or exile us to Babylon!
name: Azariah, Johanan and the arrogant men

speaker: god
text: In the sight of the Jews, pick up some large stones and bury them in the clay of the brick pavement at the entrance to Pharaoh’s palace at Tahpanhes.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then tell them that this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘I will send for My servant Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and I will set his throne over these stones that I have embedded, and he will spread his royal pavilion over them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: He will come and strike down the land of Egypt, bringing death to those destined for death, captivity to those destined for captivity, and the sword to those destined for the sword.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will kindle a fire in the temples of the gods of Egypt, and Nebuchadnezzar will burn those temples and take their gods as captives. So he will wrap himself with the land of Egypt as a shepherd wraps himself in his garment, and he will depart from there unscathed.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: He will demolish the sacred pillars of the temple of the sun in the land of Egypt, and he will burn down the temples of the gods of Egypt.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: You have seen all the disaster that I brought against Jerusalem and all the cities of Judah; and behold, they lie today in ruins and desolation
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: because of the evil they have done. They provoked Me to anger by continuing to burn incense and to serve other gods that neither they nor you nor your fathers ever knew.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Yet I sent you all My servants the prophets again and again, saying: ‘Do not do this detestable thing that I hate.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But they did not listen or incline their ears; they did not turn from their wickedness or stop burning incense to other gods.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore My wrath and anger poured out and burned in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem, so that they have become the desolate ruin they are today.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So now, this is what the LORD God of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: Why are you doing such great harm to yourselves by cutting off from Judah man and woman, child and infant, leaving yourselves without a remnant?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Why are you provoking Me to anger by the work of your hands by burning incense to other gods in the land of Egypt, where you have gone to reside? As a result, you will be cut off and will become an object of cursing and reproach among all the nations of the earth.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Have you forgotten the wickedness of your fathers and of the kings of Judah and their wives, as well as the wickedness that you and your wives committed in the land of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: To this day they have not humbled themselves or shown reverence, nor have they followed My instruction or the statutes that I set before you and your fathers.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: I will set My face to bring disaster and to cut off all Judah.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And I will take away the remnant of Judah who have resolved to go to the land of Egypt to reside there; they will meet their end. They will all fall by the sword or be consumed by famine. From the least to the greatest, they will die by sword or famine; and they will become an object of cursing and horror, of vilification and reproach.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will punish those who live in the land of Egypt, just as I punished Jerusalem, by sword and famine and plague,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: so that none of the remnant of Judah who have gone to reside in Egypt will escape or survive to return to the land of Judah, where they long to return and live; for none will return except a few fugitives.
name: The LORD

speaker: judah-in-egypt
text: As for the word you have spoken to us in the name of the LORD, we will not listen to you!
name: The people in Egypt

speaker: judah-in-egypt
text: Instead, we will do everything we vowed to do: We will burn incense to the Queen of Heaven and offer drink offerings to her, just as we, our fathers, our kings, and our officials did in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem. At that time we had plenty of food and good things, and we saw no disaster.
name: The people in Egypt

speaker: judah-in-egypt
text: But from the time we stopped burning incense to the Queen of Heaven and pouring out drink offerings to her, we have lacked everything and have been perishing by sword and famine.
name: The people in Egypt

speaker: judah-in-egypt
text: Moreover,
name: The people in Egypt

speaker: judah-in-egypt
text: when we burned incense to the Queen of Heaven and poured out drink offerings to her, was it without our husbands’ knowledge that we made sacrificial cakes in her image and poured out drink offerings to her?
name: The people in Egypt

speaker: jeremiah
text: As for the incense you burned in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem—you, your fathers, your kings, your officials, and the people of the land—did the LORD not remember and bring this to mind?
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: So the LORD could no longer endure the evil deeds and detestable acts you committed, and your land became a desolation, a horror, and an object of cursing, without inhabitant, as it is this day.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: Because you burned incense and sinned against the LORD, and did not obey the voice of the LORD or walk in His instruction, His statutes, and His testimonies, this disaster has befallen you, as you see today.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: Hear the word of the LORD, all those of Judah who are in the land of Egypt.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: As for you and your wives, you have spoken with your mouths and fulfilled with your hands your words: ‘We will surely perform our vows that we have made to burn incense to the Queen of Heaven and to pour out drink offerings to her.’ Go ahead, then, do what you have promised! Keep your vows!
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: Nevertheless, hear the word of the LORD, all you people of Judah living in Egypt: Behold, I have sworn by My great name, says the LORD, that never again will any man of Judah living in the land of Egypt invoke My name or say, ‘As surely as the Lord GOD lives.’
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: I am watching over them for harm and not for good, and every man of Judah who is in the land of Egypt will meet his end by sword or famine, until they are finished off.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: Those who escape the sword will return from Egypt to Judah, few in number, and the whole remnant of Judah who went to dwell in the land of Egypt will know whose word will stand, Mine or theirs!
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: This will be a sign to you that I will punish you in this place, declares the LORD, so that you may know that My threats of harm against you will surely stand.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: This is what the LORD says: Behold, I will deliver Pharaoh Hophra king of Egypt into the hands of his enemies who seek his life, just as I delivered Zedekiah king of Judah into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the enemy who was seeking his life.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: god
text: This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says to you, Baruch:
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You have said, ‘Woe is me because the LORD has added sorrow to my pain! I am worn out with groaning and have found no rest.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: This is what the LORD says: Throughout the land I will demolish what I have built and uproot what I have planted.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But as for you, do you seek great things for yourself? Stop seeking! For I will bring disaster on every living creature, declares the LORD, but wherever you go, I will grant your life as a spoil of war.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Deploy your shields, small and large; advance for battle!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Harness the horses; mount the steeds; take your positions with helmets on! Polish your spears; put on armor!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Why am I seeing this? They are terrified, they are retreating; their warriors are defeated, they flee in haste without looking back; terror is on every side!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The swift cannot flee, and the warrior cannot escape! In the north by the River Euphrates they stumble and fall.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Who is this, rising like the Nile, like rivers whose waters churn?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Egypt rises like the Nile, and its waters churn like rivers, boasting, ‘I will rise and cover the earth; I will destroy the cities and their people.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Advance, O horses! Race furiously, O chariots! Let the warriors come forth— Cush and Put carrying their shields, men of Lydia drawing the bow.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For that day belongs to the Lord GOD of Hosts, a day of vengeance against His foes. The sword will devour until it is satisfied, until it is quenched with their blood. For the Lord GOD of Hosts will hold a sacrifice in the land of the north by the River Euphrates.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Go up to Gilead for balm, O Virgin Daughter of Egypt! In vain you try many remedies, but for you there is no healing.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The nations have heard of your shame, and your outcry fills the earth, because warrior stumbles over warrior and both of them have fallen together.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Announce it in Egypt, and proclaim it in Migdol; proclaim it in Memphis and Tahpanhes: ‘Take your positions and prepare yourself, for the sword devours those around you.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Why have your warriors been laid low? They cannot stand, for the LORD has thrust them down.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They continue to stumble; indeed, they have fallen over one another. They say, ‘Get up! Let us return to our people and to the land of our birth, away from the sword of the oppressor.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: There they will cry out: ‘Pharaoh king of Egypt was all noise; he has let the appointed time pass him by.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: As surely as I live, declares the King, whose name is the LORD of Hosts, there will come one who is like Tabor among the mountains and like Carmel by the sea.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Pack your bags for exile, O daughter dwelling in Egypt! For Memphis will be laid waste, destroyed and uninhabited.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Egypt is a beautiful heifer, but a gadfly from the north is coming against her.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Even the mercenaries among her are like fattened calves. They too will turn back; together they will flee, they will not stand their ground, for the day of calamity is coming upon them— the time of their punishment.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Egypt will hiss like a fleeing serpent, for the enemy will advance in force; with axes they will come against her like woodsmen cutting down trees.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They will chop down her forest, declares the LORD, dense though it may be, for they are more numerous than locusts; they cannot be counted.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The Daughter of Egypt will be put to shame; she will be delivered into the hands of the people of the north.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, I am about to punish Amon god of Thebes, along with Pharaoh, Egypt with her gods and kings, and those who trust in Pharaoh.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will deliver them into the hands of those who seek their lives—of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and his officers. But after this, Egypt will be inhabited as in days of old, declares the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But you, O Jacob My servant, do not be afraid, and do not be dismayed, O Israel. For I will surely save you out of a distant place, your descendants from the land of their captivity! Jacob will return to quiet and ease, with no one to make him afraid.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And you, My servant Jacob, do not be afraid, declares the LORD, for I am with you. Though I will completely destroy all the nations to which I have banished you, I will not completely destroy you. Yet I will discipline you justly, and will by no means leave you unpunished.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: See how the waters are rising from the north and becoming an overflowing torrent. They will overflow the land and its fullness, the cities and their inhabitants. The people will cry out, and all who dwell in the land will wail
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: at the sound of the galloping hooves of stallions, the rumbling of chariots, and the clatter of their wheels. The fathers will not turn back for their sons; their hands will hang limp.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For the day has come to destroy all the Philistines, to cut off from Tyre and Sidon every remaining ally. Indeed, the LORD is about to destroy the Philistines, the remnant from the coasts of Caphtor.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The people of Gaza will shave their heads in mourning; Ashkelon will be silenced. O remnant of their valley, how long will you gash yourself?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: ‘Alas, O sword of the LORD, how long until you rest? Return to your sheath; cease and be still!’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: How can it rest when the LORD has commanded it? He has appointed it against Ashkelon and the shore of its coastland.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Woe to Nebo, for it will be devastated. Kiriathaim will be captured and disgraced; the fortress will be shattered and dismantled.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: There is no longer praise for Moab; in Heshbon they devise evil against her: ‘Come, let us cut her off from nationhood.’ You too, O people of Madmen, will be silenced; the sword will pursue you.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
