text: A voice cries out from Horonaim: ‘Devastation and great destruction!’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Moab will be shattered; her little ones will cry out.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For on the ascent to Luhith they weep bitterly as they go, and on the descent to Horonaim cries of distress resound over the destruction:
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: ‘Flee! Run for your lives! Become like a juniper in the desert.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Because you trust in your works and treasures, you too will be captured, and Chemosh will go into exile with his priests and officials.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The destroyer will move against every city, and not one town will escape. The valley will also be ruined, and the high plain will be destroyed, as the LORD has said.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Put salt on Moab, for she will be laid waste; her cities will become desolate, with no one to dwell in them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Cursed is the one who is remiss in doing the work of the LORD, and cursed is he who withholds his sword from bloodshed.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Moab has been at ease from youth, settled like wine on its dregs; he has not been poured from vessel to vessel or gone into exile. So his flavor has remained the same, and his aroma is unchanged.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when I will send to him wanderers, who will pour him out. They will empty his vessels and shatter his jars.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then Moab will be ashamed of Chemosh, just as the house of Israel was ashamed when they trusted in Bethel.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: How can you say, ‘We are warriors, mighty men ready for battle’?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Moab has been destroyed and its towns have been invaded; the best of its young men have gone down in the slaughter, declares the King, whose name is the LORD of Hosts.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Moab’s calamity is at hand, and his affliction is rushing swiftly.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Mourn for him, all you who surround him, everyone who knows his name; tell how the mighty scepter is shattered— the glorious staff!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Come down from your glory; sit on parched ground, O daughter dwelling in Dibon, for the destroyer of Moab has come against you; he has destroyed your fortresses.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Stand by the road and watch, O dweller of Aroer! Ask the man fleeing or the woman escaping, ‘What has happened?’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Moab is put to shame, for it has been shattered. Wail and cry out! Declare by the Arnon that Moab is destroyed.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Judgment has come upon the high plain— upon Holon, Jahzah, and Mephaath,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: upon Dibon, Nebo, and Beth-diblathaim,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: upon Kiriathaim, Beth-gamul, and Beth-meon,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: upon Kerioth, Bozrah, and all the towns of Moab, those far and near.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The horn of Moab has been cut off, and his arm is broken,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Make him drunk, because he has magnified himself against the LORD; so Moab will wallow in his own vomit, and he will also become a laughingstock.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Was not Israel your object of ridicule? Was he ever found among thieves? For whenever you speak of him you shake your head.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Abandon the towns and settle among the rocks, O dwellers of Moab! Be like a dove that nests at the mouth of a cave.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: We have heard of Moab’s pomposity, his exceeding pride and conceit, his proud arrogance and haughtiness of heart.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I know his insolence,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: but it is futile. His boasting is as empty as his deeds.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore I will wail for Moab; I will cry out for all of Moab; I will moan for the men of Kir-heres.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will weep for you, O vine of Sibmah, more than I weep for Jazer. Your tendrils have extended to the sea; they reach even to Jazer. The destroyer has descended on your summer fruit and grape harvest.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Joy and gladness are removed from the orchard and from the fields of Moab. I have stopped the flow of wine from the presses; no one treads them with shouts of joy; their shouts are not for joy.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: There is a cry from Heshbon to Elealeh; they raise their voices to Jahaz, from Zoar to Horonaim and Eglath-shelishiyah; for even the waters of Nimrim have dried up.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: In Moab, declares the LORD, I will bring an end to those who make offerings on the high places and burn incense to their gods.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore My heart laments like a flute for Moab; it laments like a flute for the men of Kir-heres, because the wealth they acquired has perished.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For every head is shaved and every beard is clipped; on every hand is a gash, and around every waist is sackcloth.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: On all the rooftops of Moab and in the public squares, everyone is mourning; for I have shattered Moab like an unwanted jar,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: How shattered it is! How they wail! How Moab has turned his back in shame! Moab has become an object of ridicule and horror to all those around him.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, an eagle swoops down and spreads his wings against Moab.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Kirioth has been taken, and the strongholds seized. In that day the heart of Moab’s warriors will be like the heart of a woman in labor.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Moab will be destroyed as a nation because he vaunted himself against the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Terror and pit and snare await you, O dweller of Moab,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Whoever flees the panic will fall into the pit, and whoever climbs from the pit will be caught in the snare. For I will bring upon Moab the year of their punishment,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Those who flee will stand helpless in Heshbon’s shadow, because fire has gone forth from Heshbon and a flame from within Sihon. It devours the foreheads of Moab and the skulls of the sons of tumult.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Woe to you, O Moab! The people of Chemosh have perished; for your sons have been taken into exile and your daughters have gone into captivity.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Yet in the latter days I will restore Moab from captivity,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Has Israel no sons? Is he without heir? Why then has Milcom taken possession of Gad? Why have his people settled in their cities?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore, behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when I will sound the battle cry against Rabbah of the Ammonites. It will become a heap of ruins, and its villages will be burned. Then Israel will drive out their dispossessors, says the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Wail, O Heshbon, for Ai has been destroyed; cry out, O daughters of Rabbah! Put on sackcloth and mourn; run back and forth within your walls, for Milcom will go into exile together with his priests and officials.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Why do you boast of your valleys— your valleys so fruitful, O faithless daughter? You trust in your riches and say, ‘Who can come against me?’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, I am about to bring terror upon you, declares the Lord GOD of Hosts, from all those around you. You will each be driven headlong, with no one to regather the fugitives.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Yet afterward I will restore the Ammonites from captivity,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Is there no longer wisdom in Teman? Has counsel perished from the prudent? Has their wisdom decayed?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Turn and run! Lie low, O dwellers of Dedan, for I will bring disaster on Esau at the time I punish him.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: If grape gatherers came to you, would they not leave some gleanings? Were thieves to come in the night, would they not steal only what they wanted?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But I will strip Esau bare; I will uncover his hiding places, and he will be unable to conceal himself. His descendants will be destroyed along with his relatives and neighbors, and he will be no more.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Abandon your orphans; I will preserve their lives. Let your widows trust in Me.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: If those who do not deserve to drink the cup must drink it, can you possibly remain unpunished? You will not go unpunished, for you must drink it too.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For by Myself I have sworn, declares the LORD, that Bozrah will become a desolation, a disgrace, a ruin, and a curse, and all her cities will be in ruins forever.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Assemble yourselves to march against her! Rise up for battle!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For behold, I will make you small among nations, despised among men.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The terror you cause and the pride of your heart have deceived you, O dwellers in the clefts of the rocks, O occupiers of the mountain summit. Though you elevate your nest like the eagle, even from there I will bring you down,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Edom will become an object of horror. All who pass by will be appalled and will scoff at all her wounds.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: As Sodom and Gomorrah were overthrown along with their neighbors,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: no one will dwell there; no man will abide there.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, one will come up like a lion from the thickets of the Jordan to the watered pasture. For in an instant I will chase Edom from her land. Who is the chosen one I will appoint for this? For who is like Me, and who can challenge Me? What shepherd can stand against Me?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Hamath and Arpad are put to shame, for they have heard a bad report; they are agitated like the sea; their anxiety cannot be calmed.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Damascus has become feeble; she has turned to flee. Panic has gripped her; anguish and pain have seized her like a woman in labor.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: How is the city of praise not forsaken, the town that brings Me joy?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For her young men will fall in the streets, and all her warriors will be silenced in that day,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will set fire to the walls of Damascus; it will consume the fortresses of Ben-hadad.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Rise up, advance against Kedar, and destroy the people of the east!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They will take their tents and flocks, their tent curtains and all their goods. They will take their camels for themselves. They will shout to them: ‘Terror is on every side!’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Run! Escape quickly! Lie low, O residents of Hazor,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has drawn up a plan against you; he has devised a strategy against you.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Rise up, advance against a nation at ease, one that dwells securely,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They have no gates or bars; they live alone.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Their camels will become plunder, and their large herds will be spoil. I will scatter to the wind in every direction those who shave their temples; I will bring calamity on them from all sides,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Hazor will become a haunt for jackals, a desolation forever. No one will dwell there; no man will abide there.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, I will shatter Elam’s bow, the mainstay of their might.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will bring the four winds against Elam from the four corners of the heavens, and I will scatter them to all these winds. There will not be a nation to which Elam’s exiles will not go.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So I will shatter Elam before their foes, before those who seek their lives. I will bring disaster upon them, even My fierce anger,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will send out the sword after them until I finish them off.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will set My throne in Elam, and destroy its king and officials,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Yet in the last days, I will restore Elam from captivity,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Announce and declare to the nations; lift up a banner and proclaim it; hold nothing back when you say, ‘Babylon is captured; Bel is put to shame; Marduk is shattered, her images are disgraced, her idols are broken in pieces.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For a nation from the north will come against her; it will make her land a desolation. No one will live in it; both man and beast will flee.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: In those days and at that time, declares the LORD, the children of Israel and the children of Judah will come together, weeping as they come, and will seek the LORD their God.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They will ask the way to Zion and turn their faces toward it. They will come and join themselves to the LORD in an everlasting covenant that will never be forgotten.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: My people are lost sheep; their shepherds have led them astray, causing them to roam the mountains. They have wandered from mountain to hill; they have forgotten their resting place.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: All who found them devoured them, and their enemies said, ‘We are not guilty, for they have sinned against the LORD, their true pasture, the LORD, the hope of their fathers.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Flee from the midst of Babylon; depart from the land of the Chaldeans; be like the he-goats that lead the flock.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For behold, I stir up and bring against Babylon an assembly of great nations from the land of the north. They will line up against her; from the north she will be captured. Their arrows will be like skilled warriors who do not return empty-handed.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Chaldea will be plundered; all who plunder her will have their fill,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Because you rejoice, because you sing in triumph— you who plunder My inheritance— because you frolic like a heifer treading grain and neigh like stallions,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: your mother will be greatly ashamed; she who bore you will be disgraced. Behold, she will be the least of the nations, a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Because of the wrath of the LORD, she will not be inhabited; she will become completely desolate. All who pass through Babylon will be horrified and will hiss at all her wounds.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Line up in formation around Babylon, all you who draw the bow! Shoot at her! Spare no arrows! For she has sinned against the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Raise a war cry against her on every side! She has thrown up her hands in surrender; her towers have fallen; her walls are torn down. Since this is the vengeance of the LORD, take out your vengeance upon her; as she has done, do the same to her.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and the one who wields the sickle at harvest time. In the face of the oppressor’s sword, each will turn to his own people, each will flee to his own land.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Israel is a scattered flock, chased away by lions. The first to devour him was the king of Assyria; the last to crush his bones was Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will punish the king of Babylon and his land as I punished the king of Assyria.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will return Israel to his pasture, and he will graze on Carmel and Bashan; his soul will be satisfied on the hills of Ephraim and Gilead.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: In those days and at that time, declares the LORD, a search will be made for Israel’s guilt, but there will be none, and for Judah’s sins, but they will not be found; for I will forgive the remnant I preserve.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Go up against the land of Merathaim, and against the residents of Pekod. Kill them and devote them to destruction. Do all that I have commanded you,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The noise of battle is in the land— the noise of great destruction.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: How the hammer of the whole earth lies broken and shattered! What a horror Babylon has become among the nations!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I laid a snare for you, O Babylon, and you were caught before you knew it. You were found and captured because you challenged the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The LORD has opened His armory and brought out His weapons of wrath, for this is the work of the Lord GOD of Hosts in the land of the Chaldeans.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Come against her from the farthest border. Break open her granaries; pile her up like mounds of grain. Devote her to destruction; leave her no survivors.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Kill all her young bulls; let them go down to the slaughter. Woe to them, for their day has come— the time of their punishment.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Listen to the fugitives and refugees from the land of Babylon, declaring in Zion the vengeance of the LORD our God, the vengeance for His temple.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Summon the archers against Babylon, all who string the bow. Encamp all around her; let no one escape. Repay her according to her deeds; do to her as she has done. For she has defied the LORD, the Holy One of Israel.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore, her young men will fall in the streets, and all her warriors will be silenced in that day,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, I am against you, O arrogant one,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: for your day has come, the time when I will punish you.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The arrogant one will stumble and fall with no one to pick him up. And I will kindle a fire in his cities to consume all those around him.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The sons of Israel are oppressed, and the sons of Judah as well. All their captors hold them fast, refusing to release them.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Their Redeemer is strong; the LORD of Hosts is His name. He will fervently plead their case so that He may bring rest to the earth, but turmoil to those who live in Babylon.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: A sword is against the Chaldeans, declares the LORD, against those who live in Babylon, and against her officials and wise men.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: A sword is against her false prophets, and they will become fools. A sword is against her warriors, and they will be filled with terror.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: A sword is against her horses and chariots and against all the foreigners in her midst, and they will become like women. A sword is against her treasuries, and they will be plundered.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: A drought is upon her waters, and they will be dried up. For it is a land of graven images, and the people go mad over idols.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So the desert creatures and hyenas will live there and ostriches will dwell there. It will never again be inhabited or lived in from generation to generation.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah along with their neighbors,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: no one will dwell there; no man will abide there.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, an army is coming from the north; a great nation and many kings are stirred up from the ends of the earth.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They grasp the bow and spear; they are cruel and merciless. Their voice roars like the sea, and they ride upon horses, lined up like men in formation against you, O Daughter of Babylon.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The king of Babylon has heard the report, and his hands hang limp. Anguish has gripped him, pain like that of a woman in labor.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, one will come up like a lion from the thickets of the Jordan to the watered pasture. For in an instant I will chase Babylon from her land. Who is the chosen one I will appoint for this? For who is like Me, and who can challenge Me? What shepherd can stand against Me?
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, I will stir up against Babylon and against the people of Leb-kamai the spirit of a destroyer.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will send strangers to Babylon to winnow her and empty her land; for they will come against her from every side in her day of disaster.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Do not let the archer bend his bow or put on his armor. Do not spare her young men; devote all her army to destruction!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And they will fall slain in the land of the Chaldeans, and pierced through in her streets.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For Israel and Judah have not been abandoned by their God, the LORD of Hosts, though their land is full of guilt before the Holy One of Israel.
name: The LORD

speaker: foreigners
text: We tried to heal Babylon, but she could not be healed. Abandon her! Let each of us go to his own land, for her judgment extends to the sky and reaches to the clouds.
name: Babylon's helpers

speaker: israelites
text: The LORD has brought forth our vindication; come, let us tell in Zion what the LORD our God has accomplished.
name: The people of Judah

speaker: god
text: Surely I will fill you up with men as with locusts, and they will shout in triumph over you.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You are My war club, My weapon for battle. With you I shatter nations; with you I bring kingdoms to ruin.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: With you I shatter the horse and rider; with you I shatter the chariot and driver.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: With you I shatter man and woman; with you I shatter the old man and the youth; with you I shatter the young man and the maiden.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: With you I shatter the shepherd and his flock; with you I shatter the farmer and his oxen; with you I shatter the governors and officials.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Before your very eyes I will repay Babylon and all the dwellers of Chaldea for all the evil they have done in Zion,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Behold, I am against you, O destroying mountain, you who devastate the whole earth, declares the LORD. I will stretch out My hand against you; I will roll you over the cliffs and turn you into a charred mountain.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: No one shall retrieve from you a cornerstone or a foundation stone, because you will become desolate forever,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Raise a banner in the land! Blow the ram’s horn among the nations! Prepare the nations against her. Summon the kingdoms against her— Ararat, Minni, and Ashkenaz. Appoint a captain against her; bring up horses like swarming locusts.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Prepare the nations for battle against her— the kings of the Medes, their governors and all their officials, and all the lands they rule.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The earth quakes and writhes because the LORD’s intentions against Babylon stand: to make the land of Babylon a desolation, without inhabitant.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The warriors of Babylon have stopped fighting; they sit in their strongholds. Their strength is exhausted; they have become like women. Babylon’s homes have been set ablaze, the bars of her gates are broken.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: One courier races to meet another, and messenger follows messenger, to announce to the king of Babylon that his city has been captured from end to end.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The fords have been seized, the marshes set on fire, and the soldiers are terrified.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The Daughter of Babylon is like a threshing floor at the time it is trampled. In just a little while her harvest time will come.
name: The LORD

speaker: zion-dweller
text: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has devoured me; he has crushed me. He has set me aside like an empty vessel; he has swallowed me like a monster; he filled his belly with my delicacies and vomited me out.
name: The dweller of Zion

speaker: zion-dweller
text: May the violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babylon,
name: The dweller of Zion

speaker: zion-dweller
text: May my blood be on the dwellers of Chaldea,
name: The dweller of Zion

speaker: god
text: Behold, I will plead your case and take vengeance on your behalf; I will dry up her sea and make her springs run dry.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Babylon will become a heap of rubble, a haunt for jackals, an object of horror and scorn, without inhabitant.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: They will roar together like young lions; they will growl like lion cubs.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: While they are flushed with heat, I will serve them a feast, and I will make them drunk so that they may revel; then they will fall asleep forever and never wake up, declares the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with male goats.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: How Sheshach has been captured! The praise of all the earth has been seized. What a horror Babylon has become among the nations!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The sea has come up over Babylon; she is covered in turbulent waves.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Her cities have become a desolation, a dry and arid land, a land where no one lives, where no son of man passes through.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will punish Bel in Babylon. I will make him spew out what he swallowed. The nations will no longer stream to him; even the wall of Babylon will fall.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Come out of her, My people! Save your lives, each of you, from the fierce anger of the LORD.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Do not let your heart grow faint, and do not be afraid when the rumor is heard in the land; for a rumor will come one year— and then another the next year— of violence in the land and of ruler against ruler.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Therefore, behold, the days are coming when I will punish the idols of Babylon. Her entire land will suffer shame, and all her slain will lie fallen within her.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then heaven and earth and all that is in them will shout for joy over Babylon because the destroyers from the north will come against her,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Babylon must fall on account of the slain of Israel, just as the slain of all the earth have fallen because of Babylon.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You who have escaped the sword, depart and do not linger! Remember the LORD from far away, and let Jerusalem come to mind.
name: The LORD

speaker: exiles
text: We are ashamed because we have heard reproach; disgrace has covered our faces, because foreigners have entered the holy places of the LORD’s house.
name: The exiles

speaker: god
text: Therefore, behold, the days are coming,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: when I will punish her idols, and throughout her land the wounded will groan.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Even if Babylon ascends to the heavens and fortifies her lofty stronghold, the destroyers I send will come against her,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: The sound of a cry comes from Babylon, the sound of great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans!
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For the LORD will destroy Babylon; He will silence her mighty voice. The waves will roar like great waters; the tumult of their voices will resound.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: For a destroyer is coming against her— against Babylon. Her warriors will be captured, and their bows will be broken, for the LORD is a God of retribution; He will repay in full.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: I will make her princes and wise men drunk, along with her governors, officials, and warriors. Then they will fall asleep forever and not wake up,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Babylon’s thick walls will be leveled, and her high gates consumed by fire. So the labor of the people will be for nothing; the nations will exhaust themselves to fuel the flames.
name: The LORD

speaker: jeremiah
text: When you get to Babylon, see that you read all these words aloud,
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: and say, ‘O LORD, You have promised to cut off this place so that no one will remain—neither man nor beast. Indeed, it will be desolate forever.’
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: When you finish reading this scroll, tie a stone to it and cast it into the Euphrates.
name: Jeremiah

speaker: jeremiah
text: Then you are to say, ‘In the same way Babylon will sink and never rise again, because of the disaster I will bring upon her. And her people will grow weary.’
name: Jeremiah
